title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nagarro is a global digital engineering company that helps organizations become human\-centric, digital\-first businesses. The company focuses on future\-proofing clients through a forward\-thinking, fluid, and caring mindset that emphasizes responsiveness, efficiency, creativity, and sustainability. With more than 17,500 experts across 39 countries, Nagarro offers diverse, international perspectives and deep technical expertise. Team members join a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment where they support customers in solving complex business and technology challenges.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior Product Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram, India. This role is responsible for defining product vision and strategy, translating customer and business needs into clear product roadmaps, and prioritizing features and enhancements. Day\-to\-day activities include gathering and analyzing market and user insights, writing product requirements, coordinating with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams, and overseeing the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from discovery to launch and iteration. The Senior Product Manager will track product performance through metrics and feedback, refine the backlog, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality releases. This role also involves guiding stakeholders, managing risks, and mentoring junior product team members to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Proven experience in product management, including product strategy, roadmap development, and backlog prioritization for digital or software products.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret market research, user data, and business metrics to inform decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver successful product outcomes.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills, including the ability to present complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* Experience with agile or lean product development methodologies and tools commonly used in modern product organizations.
* Background in technology, business, or a related field; a bachelor’s degree is required, and a master’s degree (e.g., MBA) is an advantage.
* Prior experience leading products in a digital engineering or IT services environment; experience in global or multi\-country setups is a plus.
* Ability to work on\-site in Delhi, India, with a collaborative mindset and commitment to inclusive, non\-discriminatory practices.

title: Vice President, AI Solutions
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago\-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle\-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
   

  

 The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround \& Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution\-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
   

  

 Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high\-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.\-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long\-term growth in a high\-performance environment.
   

  

 The Vice President, AI Solutions role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to lead the end\-to\-end design, development and delivery of AI\-driven solutions that redefine how the firm operates and serves its clients. This Vice President will own discrete AI product workstreams, guide junior team members, report to the Director of AI Solutions and collaborate with senior stakeholders to bring scalable agentic AI platforms to life. This person will bridge technical depth and business acumen, translating complex consulting frameworks into production\-ready AI workflows. If you are a technically strong leader who thrives in high\-performance environments and wants to drive the future of AI in consulting, this is the right role for you.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development and delivery of agentic AI solutions and automation workflows that encode Portage Point’s financial and operational advisory methodologies into scalable, reliable platforms
* Own end\-to\-end AI product workstreams from requirements gathering and prototyping through deployment, monitoring and iteration
* Apply AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) to drive rapid, high\-quality development and establish engineering best practices for the AI Solutions team
* Collaborate with Practice Line Leaders, Delivery Enablement teams and domain experts to translate business requirements into AI\-powered product features and workflows
* Manage and mentor junior team members, providing technical guidance, code reviews and professional development support
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tools, LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks, recommending and implementing the most impactful technologies
* Define and enforce AI governance standards including prompt safety, data privacy, bias mitigation and responsible AI practices across all workstreams
* Drive measurable impact by tracking solution performance, adoption metrics and ROI, and iterating based on stakeholder feedback
* Lead internal knowledge sharing sessions, training and documentation efforts to scale AI capability across the firm
* Support business development efforts by contributing to AI\-related proposals, client presentations and solution demonstrations
* Support talent acquisition and firm\-building initiatives
* Contribute to a high\-performing, inclusive and values\-driven culture


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or a related technical field from a top undergraduate program; MBA or advanced degree preferred
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Ability to collaborate across global time zones, including US\-based teams
* Five to nine years of progressive experience in AI/ML development, software engineering or a related technical discipline; management consulting or professional services experience is a plus
* Proven track record of building and delivering LLM\-powered applications, agentic AI solutions and automation workflows at scale
* Expert\-level proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and strong development skills in Python or JavaScript
* Deep experience with AI/ML frameworks, APIs and orchestration platforms including tools such as OpenAI, Claude, LangChain, N8N, Zapier or similar
* Strong understanding of data engineering, model evaluation, MLOps and modern software development practices
* Demonstrated ability to embed responsible AI principles, including bias detection, explainability and data privacy, into production AI systems
* Proven ability to manage and mentor junior team members and drive delivery across cross\-functional teams
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast\-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high\-pressure environments
* Ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

**The Impact You’ll Drive**
 We are seeking a
 *Senior Product Manager* 
 to own critical areas of our credit and banking platform. You will work across product strategy, customer discovery, platform design, and execution to build scalable financial infrastructure for banks, NBFCs, fintechs, and enterprises.

* Own product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for one or more areas of the platform.

* Work directly with banks, NBFCs, fintechs, and enterprise customers to understand requirements and translate them into scalable platform capabilities.
* Partner with engineering, design, risk, compliance, operations, and implementation teams to take products from discovery to production and scale.
* Define APIs, workflows, rules, configurations, integrations, and data models in collaboration with engineering.
* Identify common customer requirements and turn them into reusable platform capabilities rather than bespoke solutions.
* Define product metrics and use customer feedback and data to drive continuous improvement.
* Make product trade\-offs across customer needs, business impact, technical complexity, scalability, and regulatory requirements.


**The Perfect Fit**
* 5\+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in fintech, banking, lending, payments, or B2B SaaS.
* Hands\-on experience building products in credit, lending, banking infrastructure, payments, or financial services.
* Strong understanding of financial product lifecycles and operational workflows.
* Experience working with banks, NBFCs, fintechs, or financial institutions.
* Experience building configurable products or platforms serving multiple customers.
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, system architecture, and data flows.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, scalable product solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Comfortable operating independently in fast\-moving environments.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive problems from definition to execution and outcomes.


*Your Edge Over The Rest*
* Experience with LOS/LMS, underwriting, decision engines, KYC, bureau, payments, ledger, or collections.
* Understanding of RBI regulations relevant to lending, credit, payments, and KYC.
* Experience building APIs, configurable workflows, or platform products.
* Experience taking products from 0→1 and 1→N.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring PMs or influencing product direction across teams.


**The Problem We’re Solving**
 Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 At the same time, customer expectations have changed \- speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.

 At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control \- helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.

* Work at the intersection of fintech innovation and regulated banking infrastructure
* High ownership role with end\-to\-end product responsibility
* Opportunity to solve complex, real\-world problems in credit, underwriting, and onboarding
* Collaborate closely with experienced leaders across product, banking, and fintech ecosystems
* Fast\-paced, execution\-driven culture where your work directly impacts business outcomes
* Be part of a growing fintech shaping next\-gen credit infrastructure in India

title: Senior Associate -Digital Product Management
description:
**Job Description**
 Enterprise Data Platforms (EDP) enables the enterprise with trusted, governed, and actionable data through modern digital products and platforms. The team transforms enterprise warehouse data into intuitive, scalable experiences that help users discover, access, analyze, and derive insights from data.
   

  

 As an Sr. Associate Product Owner – Digital Data Products, you will support the development and delivery of enterprise data products built on modern cloud and data platforms, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will work closely with business, data, technology, and design teams to translate user needs and complex data capabilities into simple, high\-value digital experiences.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an interest in product management, data, cloud technologies, and AI/GenAI\-enabled digital experiences.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support the product roadmap, backlog, and delivery of enterprise digital data products and platform capabilities.
* Understand enterprise user journeys and help identify opportunities to simplify how users discover, access, consume, and derive insights from warehouse data through best\-in\-class digital products.
* Identify and evaluate AI/GenAI opportunities across digital product journeys, including potential business benefits, productivity improvements, adoption, and success measures.
* Translate business and user needs into well\-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Participate in product discovery, requirements gathering, backlog refinement, prioritization, solution\-design discussions, sprint planning, testing, and product releases.
* Collaborate with UX/design, engineering, architecture, data analytics, governance, and business teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and reliable data products.
* Support the definition and tracking of product KPIs, adoption, user experience, and business outcomes, and use data and user feedback to identify opportunities for product enhancement.
* Assist in ensuring data security, privacy, governance, entitlement, and compliance requirements are incorporated into product features and user journeys.
* Identify and track product dependencies, risks, issues, and delivery milestones, escalating where appropriate and supporting timely resolution.
* Create product documentation, stakeholder communications, demonstrations, release readiness, and adoption activities.
* Develop an understanding of emerging capabilities across cloud, data, analytics, AI, and GenAI and contribute ideas for product innovation and improved user experiences.
* Contribute to a customer\-centric and outcome\-driven product culture by bringing user insights, data, and structured problem\-solving into product decisions.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Business/MBA, or a related discipline.
* 3\+ years of relevant experience in digital products, data products, business analysis, product ownership/management, technology delivery, data analytics, or related roles.
* Proven Product Management/Product Ownership experience, including product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, requirements, and end\-to\-end delivery.
* Exposure to products or solutions that enable users to discover, access, analyze, or derive insights from data.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud and data ecosystems; exposure to GCP, BigQuery, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, APIs, or big\-data technologies is preferred.
* Working knowledge of one or more of the following: data warehousing, databases, SQL, data integration/pipelines, APIs, analytics, BI/reporting, and digital UI concepts.
* Experience translating complex data and technology capabilities into intuitive user experiences and measurable business value.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments; familiarity with SAFe is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across business and technology teams, manage multiple priorities, and operate in a complex enterprise environment.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop expertise across product management, cloud, data, analytics, AI, and GenAI.
* Experience or exposure to enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, data marketplaces, self\-service analytics, data governance, cloud\-based data products, or AI/GenAI\-enabled experiences is highly desirable.

+

* Support the effective use and optimization of CRM and sales technology platforms to improve sales visibility, productivity, and execution.
* Develop and maintain sales reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and performance tracking to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Support territory planning, account prioritization, opportunity management, and pipeline planning in collaboration with Sales and KAM teams.
* Ensure CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, and governance across relevant product and customer records.
* Analyze sales and customer data to identify product trends, whitespace opportunities, adoption gaps, and revenue opportunities.


**We are looking for someone with:**
**Product Management Expertise**
* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management \- ideation, development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Ability to develop product strategy, roadmap, positioning, and value proposition.
* Strong understanding of market research, customer insights, competitor analysis, and portfolio management.
* Ability to translate customer and market needs into product requirements and actionable product initiatives.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, pricing, margins, adoption, and profitability.


**Sales Enablement**
* Ability to translate product features into sales propositions and customer benefits.
* Experience developing sales decks, product brochures, battlecards, FAQs, competitor comparisons, objection\-handling guides, and product demos.
* Strong understanding of sales processes, pipeline management, account prioritization, and opportunity management.
* Ability to conduct product training and enablement sessions for Sales and KAM teams.
* Strong collaboration skills to bridge Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.


**CRM, Marketing Automation \& Technology**
* Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce/SFDC.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* Understanding of CRM data management, lead management, campaign workflows, and reporting.
* Ability to leverage technology to streamline processes and improve sales and marketing efficiency.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys is desirable.


**Data \& Analytics Expertise**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret sales, marketing, customer, product, and campaign data and convert insights into actions.
* Experience with dashboards, reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking.
* Knowledge of GA4 or similar digital analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of marketing and product KPIs including conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, pipeline, and revenue.
* Advanced MS Excel skills; familiarity with Power BI or other visualization tools is an advantage.


**Communication \& Stakeholder Management**
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex product concepts in a simple, compelling, customer\-focused manner.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, Marketing, Editorial, Technology, Finance, Operations, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for internal and external audiences.


**Strategic \& Commercial Thinking**
* Strong business acumen and commercial orientation.
* Ability to connect product decisions with revenue, margin, customer value, and business objectives.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands\-on execution mindset
* Strong understanding of competitive dynamics and ability to develop data\-backed recommendations.


**Education / Domain Knowledge**
* Preferred Educational Background: MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Product Management, Business Strategy, or related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.


**Preferred Industry Experience:**
* Higher Education Publishing
* EdTech / Digital Learning
* SaaS / Technology
* Education Services
* Academic Content / Learning Solutions

 The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As a leading education partner for millions of educators, learners, and professionals, we are expanding the possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world.

You will gain broad exposure to product, commercial, and operational functions within a globally recognized education business working with real data, real products, and real business decisions from day one.

title: Brand Category Manager
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 We're building one of India's most interesting marketing teams in the mobility space, and we need someone who can own a portfolio of channels the way a brand manager owns a category: with commercial instinct, cross\-functional pull, and a genuine drive to grow.
   

  

 This isn't a coordination role \-you will own Brand partnerships, offline distribution, and OTA set strategy, run execution, and be accountable for outcomes. You'll work directly with the India Leadership and also operate as a key node between local teams and global stakeholders.
   

  

 If you've grown up in FMCG or a fast\-scaling startup and know what it means to own a channel from the ground up, this is the job.
   

  

**About The Role**
* You think about the Flix brand in India with both a short and long term lens. Contributing to how the brand shows up across your channels today while helping shape the positioning and perception we want to build over the next 3 to 5 years
* Build and manage Flix's B2B and brand partnership pipeline in India. Identifying prospects, closing deals, onboarding partners, and tracking commercial contribution to load
* Be the external face of Flix on OTA platforms, owning platform relationships, content quality, listing health, and commercial terms across all major OTA partners in India
* Manage the offline sales network. Travel agencies, ticket shops, and kiosks — from acquisition through to partner enablement, training, and performance management
* You collaborate across marketing, performance, CRM, and product to prevent channel strategies from running in silos and to unlock shared growth levers
* Identify and pursue new distribution and partnership opportunities in the Indian market, bringing commercial rigour to everything from a first pitch to a signed deal
* You liaise with HQ and global teams to keep local channel strategies aligned with Flix's broader commercial and brand direction
* You act as the primary external point of contact for partners across B2B, offline, and OTA, representing Flix with authority


**About You**
* 3 to 5 years in brand management, category management, or channel marketing, ideally in D2C, or a high\-growth startup
* You've owned marketing spends or a channel target before, not just reported into one.
* Comfortable managing a wide portfolio without losing depth on what matters most.
* Strong negotiator and relationship builder. You can hold a room with a internal teams, external partner and on ground sales agents in the same day.
* Sharp with numbers, fast with decisions, and honest about what's working


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Business Consultant
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard\-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
   

  

**We are looking for Business Consultant**
 As a business consultant, you will guide our clients in modeling their business processes in our industry\-leading Software as a Service (SaaS) product. Do you believe you can help our clients to thrive in their business by configuring state\-of\-the\-art software to fulfill continuously evolving passenger needs? Then this role may be something for you!
   

  

 Integrating the SaaS product for a rail operator is no easy task. It concerns mission critical business processes that need to be modelled in a functionally rich and flexible SaaS product. Variations are endless, requiring deep analytical skills and good understanding of business processes, functionality and context of our clients. In addition, there is a portion in the larger IT ecosystem of our clients that typically requires custom integration. Your expertise and experience matter to successfully integrate the SaaS product in the IT landscape of our clients. As a business consultant, you are responsible for functionally solutionising the integration of existing systems with the SaaS product, both upstream (B2C, B2B and B2E frontend channels) and downstream (e.g. F\&A, CRM, RM, DWH).
   

  

 We have a global client base, ranging from North America to a strong client base in Europe. With a global go\-to\-market strategy, we are committed to expand our footprint to Asia, in particular in Indonesia. You will be a crucial element to our growth strategy in Indonesia and the wider Asia Pacific region, to deliver successful implementations with interactive workshops, consulting and training clients onsite at their offices, both within Indonesia and beyond.
   

  

 We are looking for mature consultants with hands\-on experience helping clients by defining sustainable solutions for complex challenges. You understand market and consumer trends in public transport and build a deep understanding of our clients’ business as well as our SaaS product. You can challenge the status quo and create solutions. We are open to welcoming colleagues with a background in development and/or information/ business analysis.
   

  

**You’ll make a difference by**
* Quick and adequate answering of functional and technical questions from our customers and consultants
* A low sense of hierarchy, which comes with a lot of responsibility and visibility
* Working in a multi\-cultural and international team, with colleagues from Indonesia, Netherlands, Germany and Singapore.
* An open yet challenging environment of ambitious professionals with different backgrounds


**Desired Skills:**
* Bachelor’s degree
* Strong analytical thinking skills
* You have a university degree and are willing to travel overseas
* International experience and ambition are a plus
* You can interpret difficult problems and facilitate clients towards sustainable solutions
* You are fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both verbal and in writing and can communicate in a client\-centric way
* Any additional language is a benefit
* Experience with working in an agile environment is a plus
* Demonstrable experience in translating business objectives into IT needs
* Experience working in public transportation or rail industry is a major plus
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience as a consultant or information analyst in IT
* You like having different responsibilities, working in small teams on challenging assignments.


**Join us and be yourself!**
 We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
 This role is based in Gurugram. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting \- and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

 Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers.

* Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM \& CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge \& case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS\-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root\-cause analytics).

title: Product Development Lead, Grids of the Future
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 About the Global Energy Alliance
   

  

 The Global Energy Alliance (the Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

 Grids of the Future is GEA's programme for delivering abundant, reliable, and clean electricity across the Global South. In many emerging economies, the utilities that supply most electricity are held back by aging infrastructure, underinvestment, and a lack of reliable data. Efforts to modernize often remain stuck in isolated pilots rather than reaching the whole grid. The programme works in close partnership with utilities, governments, regulators, and innovators. It supports grid digitalization, the integration of renewables and battery storage, greater demand flexibility, and a stronger network of local innovators. Together, these help emerging economies move from aging, fossil fuel dependent grids to modern grids that are ready for renewable energy. The programme brings together the policy, regulatory, and delivery work that this transition depends on.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 The Product Development Lead will lead the full end to end Product lifecycle for the Open Source solutions/products being developed by Global Energy Alliance with its Alliance partners to ensure that the valuable work being carried out by GEA and other partners in the clean energy ecosystem is supported with the right technology tools.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The position leads the end to end development including clearly defining requirements, holding the schematics, managing the vendors and delivering to internal and external stakeholders. This is a critical role to manage the delivery of the technological infrastructure supporting GEA's global Grids of the Future programme.
   

  

 It supports the Grids of the Future teams across GEA's priority markets, including India, Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Africa. The work helps low\-and\-middle\-income countries modernize their grids and integrate large volumes of low\-cost renewable energy in a reliable and financially sustainable way. The role draws on product management experience in the technology field along with strong project management skills.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
**Lead End\-to\-End Product Lifecycle \& Technology Delivery**
* Lead the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of Grids of the Future (GOTF) digital and technological infrastructure products, translating programme goals into actionable product roadmaps, clear requirements, schematics, and functional specifications, feature releases.
* Oversee the development, testing, and deployment of technology tools, incorporating AI\-powered development, tools, and rollouts to ensure digital solutions meet rigorous standards for Utility and partner deployment. Must be fluent with Open Source Software development.
* Design product requirement documents in conjunction with the GOTF architecture team


**Vendor Management, Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Manage technology vendors and external development partners throughout the project lifecycle, enforcing strict quality control, version control, risk management, and service\-level agreements.
* Oversee technical schematics, architectural frameworks, and project documentation to ensure software and digital tools are scalable, secure, interoperable, and aligned with utility operating environments.
* Maintain comprehensive project management governance, proactively managing project timelines, budgets, multi\-stakeholder dependencies, and technical deliverables.


**Regional Execution, Stakeholder Alignment \& Utility Integration**
* Partner closely with regional and country\-level GOTF teams across GEAPP priority markets (India, Southeast Asia, Latin America \& the Caribbean, and Africa) to tailor product offerings to local grid contexts, regulatory frameworks, and market conditions.
* Hire Design Partners for deployment of the products and nurture relationships with the necessary stakeholders at the Design Partner sites.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners—including distribution utilities, system operators, regulators, and clean energy ecosystem innovators—to ensure digital products address operational pain points and enable demand flexibility.
* Provide technical guidance, training, and change management support to internal teams and utility counterparts to accelerate the adoption and institutionalisation of new digital grid solutions.


**Knowledge Sharing \& Continuous Product Innovation**
* Track emerging technological advancements, AI tools, and digital grid innovations across advanced and emerging power markets, channelling actionable insights to refine GEAPP's product portfolio.
* Establish product performance metrics and impact indicators to evaluate tool adoption, operational efficacy, and contribution to clean energy access and emissions reduction goals.


**Product release and evangelization**
* Lead Product release planning and execution with the communications team. Work as the single point of contact for the feature release calendar.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience**
 The ideal candidate would be a self\-starter and be willing to “roll up their sleeves” to adapt to working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
   

  

**Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience Include**
* At least 8 years of work experience as a Product Manager, developing for Power Sector.
* A minimum bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as technology, product design, business management; an engineering or renewable energy qualification will be a strong plus.
* FOSS development experience is a priority. Candidates with already committed projects will be preferred. Understanding of AI (LLMs, inference and coding tools) is a must have.
* Strong network and relationships with power sector stakeholders across one or more of GEA's priority markets; experience spanning both Global North and Global South power systems will be a strong advantage.
* Direct experience of working with AI powered development and roll out.
* Demonstrated commitment to working to improve the lives of others and to working in the impact sector.
* Willingness to travel internationally across GEA's priority markets for project execution, if required.


**Behavioural Competencies**
 The ideal candidate should be able to demonstrate the following:
   

  

* Sector knowledge: understanding of FOSS, AI tooling and delivering technology solutions to rigorous client standards. Experience with grid modernization, renewable energy integration, distribution and transmission systems, grid flexibility, and storage in the context of global south electricity sectors, including India is a plus.
* Experience of working with utilities: good understanding of utility operations, planning, and working mechanisms, including the institutional and political complexities of state\-owned distribution companies.
* Vendor management: a track record of delivering technology projects through vendors. High levels of attention to detail, version control, risk management and clear mapping of roles and responsibilities.
* Communication \& Presentation: excellent interpersonal abilities and listening skills; strong writing and presentation skills; able to present ideas to a range of stakeholders in a clear and compelling way.
* Project Execution: strong project management skills; meets deadlines; sense of urgency and responsibility; ability to multi\-task and work under pressure; detail oriented.


*We operate from a strong commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in everything we do. It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.* 
  

  

*Global Energy Alliance is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity and compliance with all federal, state, and local laws concerning employment discrimination, including the Americans with Disabilities Act. To this end, the organization ensures equal opportunity to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, lawful alien status, physical, mental, and medical disability, veteran status, or liability for service in the United States Armed Forces.*

 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top\-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times.
   

  

 Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We help NRIs in 120\+ countries invest and manage money in India: mutual funds, fixed deposits, taxation, compliance, and repatriation.
 




**The role** 





 You'll own real product problems end to end: figure out what's broken, work out why, ship the fix with Engineering and Design, and measure whether it worked. You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, and leadership.
 





 Problems like the ones you'll work on:
 



* Why does an NRI in Dubai start onboarding and not finish?
* What makes an investor redeem, and what could have kept them?
* Which manual workflows should AI be running instead of people?



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Define winning before you build:** 

 Every initiative starts with a success metric. If you can't say what "this worked" looks like in numbers, it isn't ready.
* **Execution:** 

 Write clear requirements, drive delivery with Engineering and Design, clear blockers, and close the loop. A task is yours until the outcome is delivered, not until you hand it off.
* **Analytics:** 

 Track funnels, adoption, and conversion. Judge features by whether they move the business, not by whether they shipped.
* **Talk to users every week:** 

 Have direct conversations with NRIs across geographies. Dashboards and CS summaries don't replace them. Support tickets and payment failures are requirements we missed, and you'll help trace them to root cause.
* **AI and automation:** 

 Use AI tools daily to research, prototype, and automate. If something is repetitive, your first question should be "why isn't this automated?"
* **Experimentation:** 

 Frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and read results honestly, including when an experiment fails.



  





**What we look for** 





 You don't need PM experience. We look for evidence of how you think and build:
 



* **A product project:** 

 a college project, app, website, or prototype you took from idea to something usable
* **Analytical thinking:** 

 the ability to take apart a product, find a real user problem, and back your fix with reasoning or data
* **AI fluency:** 

 practical use of AI tools to research, prototype, or automate something real
* **Ownership:** 

 a clear example of something you drove to completion, especially when it got hard



  





**How we work** 





 Your work will be challenged, and not in quarterly reviews. It happens in the moment, by the person next to you. A design gets torn apart because an NRI in Dubai would find it confusing. A feature gets sent back because it solves our problem, not the user's. That isn't conflict; it's how craft works when people care.
 





 We don't optimize for comfort. We optimize for the NRI in San Jose at 11pm, trying to figure out if their money in India is safe. That person deserves our best thinking, our fastest execution, and our most obsessive attention to detail.
 





 If that standard feels like pressure, this isn't the right place. If it feels like the point, you'll do the best work of your life here.
 




  





**Why SBNRI** 



* A small team, so your work ships and is visible to leadership from week one
* A rare domain: cross\-border, regulated wealth for a global customer base
* A steep learning curve across product, data, compliance, and growth



  





**How to apply** 





 Email
 
**sanskriti@sbnri.com** 

 with the subject "
 
**Application for Associate Product Manager – SBNRI** 

 ." Include:
 



1. Your resume
2. **One link** 

 to something you've built or analysed. This could be a product teardown, prototype, project, or a short doc on a problem you'd fix in any app you use.



**Applications without the link won't be reviewed.**

 Aggressive ESOP allocations at the onset. We recently concluded our first ESOP buyback, and if the company continues doing well in next 3 years, this promises to be a life\-altering opportunity in terms on ESOP liquidity
* **Build in one of the highest talent density in consumer\-tech:**

 available to the whose and whose of startup ecosystem (check our angel investor list)

 We are assembling some of the smartest and highly ambitious individuals under one roof, to build a consumer\-tech company that we can be proud of. This will not be a 9\-5 well defined role, so if you're looking for one, you shouldn't consider applying.

title: Product Management Lead
description:
Management Level: 08 \- Associate Manager
   

  

 Must have skills: Product Management (B2B SaaS / Platform), Roadmap Ownership, Stakeholder Management, PRD \& Requirement Definition, AI\-assistant Product Tooling
   

  

 Good to have skills: EdTech / Learning Platforms, Product Analytics (Amplitude / Mixpanel / GA)
   

  

 Experience: Minimum 8 year(s) of experience is required with 5\+ years in a Product role
   

  

 Educational Qualification: B.Tech / BE from a Tier\-1 institute (IIT / NIT / BITS or equivalent); MBA good to have
   

  

 Job Summary:
   

  

 As a Product Manager for Accenture LearnVantage (ALV), you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our enterprise learning platform. You will translate ambiguous business needs into a clear, prioritised roadmap and drive it to execution with engineering, design, and business teams. You will become an expert on the market and client needs through research, discovery, and customer validation. You will operate as a senior voice in the room, engaging MD/SMD\-level stakeholders with confidence, challenging assumptions, and making defensible calls on prioritization and strategy.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 Own and continuously evolve the product roadmap; drive it to execution and outcomes against tight timelines and competing priorities.
   

  

 Engage MD/SMD\-level and client stakeholders with confidence — hold a point of view, push back when needed, and align senior leaders around trade\-offs.
   

  

 Lead and mentor a team of business analysts; raise the bar on discovery, problem framing, and requirement quality.
   

  

 Drive brutal prioritisation — ask the hard questions of sales and business teams, interrogate the "why" behind each ask, and say no with a rationale rather than just collecting requirements.
   

  

 Draw the product line: decide what lives in the core product, what should be handled as an off\-product customisation, and what we say “no” to, protecting platform coherence and long\-term maintainability.
   

  

 Convert ambiguous business inputs into crisp, unambiguous PRDs with clear problem statements, scope, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
   

  

 Define, instrument, and track success metrics; use product analytics to validate outcomes and inform the next iteration.
   

  

 Use AI tools fluently across the product lifecycle — discovery, PRD drafting, competitive analysis, and prototyping — to move faster and raise quality.
   

  

 Establish and run repeatable, process\-oriented product operating rhythms (intake, prioritisation, delivery, review).
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

 Must Have Skills: 5\+ years in product management with a track record of progressively senior roles and ownership — not just tenure.
   

  

 Proven ability to develop Product Sense through customer and market validation using lean discovery practices, user research, and customer validation.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to build a roadmap from scratch and execute it end\-to\-end, beating constraints and competing priorities.
   

  

 Strong executive presence; proven experience influencing MD/SMD or CXO\-level stakeholders and holding ground under pressure.
   

  

 Deep business acumen — able to judge product vs. customisation trade\-offs and tie decisions to commercial impact.
   

  

 Excellent requirement definition and PRD\-writing skills; able to turn ambiguity into clarity.
   

  

 Hands\-on with product analytics tools and metrics\-driven decision making; process\-oriented and structured.
   

  

 Fluent, practical use of AI tools in day\-to\-day product work.
   

  

 Good to Have: Prior experience in EdTech / learning platforms and experience leading business analyst teams.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a senior product leader with a Tier\-1 educational pedigree, a bias for execution, and the gravitas to lead both up (senior stakeholders) and down (a BA team).
   

  

 This role sits within Accenture LearnVantage (ALV), building the enterprise learning platform, and is based out of our Bangalore / Gurgaon office.

title: Senior Associate- Business Growth
description:
**Senior Associate – Growth \& Marketing \| Native** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Native Growth \& Marketing team, you will own some of the biggest growth levers for Native—from identifying where growth will come from to building the plan, launching it, measuring the impact, and scaling what works.
 



 Native is building a new\-age consumer brand across categories such as Water Purifiers and Smart Door Locks. In this role, you will get the opportunity to work at the intersection of
 **business, marketing, product and consumer behavior** 
 , with a direct line of sight to revenue.
 



 You will be expected to think like a business owner. That means you won't just receive a campaign brief and execute it—you will help define
 **what problem we need to solve, what the right growth lever is, how we should solve it, and how we know it worked.** 




 You will work across the entire growth funnel—from product and pricing to discovery, conversion and retention—and take initiatives from
 **0 → 1 → scale** 
 .
 



 If you are looking for a role where you can take ownership early, see the direct impact of your work on the business, and learn how to build and scale a D2C brand, this is for you.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 1\. Find the Next Growth Opportunity
 



 A big part of your role will be figuring out
 **where the next unlock is** 
 .
 



 You will:
 


* Deep dive into business and funnel data to identify opportunities and bottlenecks.
* Understand consumer behavior and speak to users to uncover what is driving—or preventing—conversion.
* Identify opportunities across product, assortment, pricing, offers, merchandising, channel experience and retention.
* Turn insights into clear hypotheses and action plans.
* Take ownership of solving the problem, not just reporting it.



 For example: Why are users dropping off? Why is one product converting better than another? Is the issue pricing, messaging, trust, discovery or the product experience? What should we test next?
 



  





 2\. Own GTM and Demand Generation End\-to\-End
 



 You will independently drive campaigns and growth initiatives from
 **strategy to execution to optimization** 
 .
 



 This includes:
 


* Identifying the objective and growth opportunity.
* Defining the target audience and proposition.
* Building the campaign and channel strategy.
* Planning budgets and expected outcomes.
* Working with internal teams to develop creatives and landing experiences.
* Setting up campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google and YouTube.
* Managing campaigns on a day\-to\-day basis.
* Tracking performance and making optimization decisions.
* Scaling successful campaigns and shutting down what isn't working.



 You will not be limited to coordinating execution. You will have the opportunity to understand how paid growth actually works—from campaign planning and setup to performance management and scale.
 



  





 3\. Own Revenue Growth Across Key Levers
 



 You will work on the levers that directly impact Native's revenue.
 



 Product \& Offering
 


* Identify opportunities to improve assortment, bundling, product positioning and merchandising.
* Improve how products are discovered and presented across e\-commerce platforms.
* Work on reviews, ratings, content and other conversion levers.
* Identify gaps in the customer journey and drive improvements.



 Pricing \& Offers
 


* Analyze pricing and conversion trends to identify opportunities.
* Build and test offers across products, channels and campaigns.
* Understand the trade\-off between discounting, conversion and revenue.
* Continuously iterate to improve offer effectiveness.



 Channel Experience
 


* Improve how Native is experienced across app/storefronts, landing pages, paid channels and CRM.
* Work on propositions, messaging and creatives to improve CTR and CVR.
* Identify and solve friction points across the purchase journey.



  





 4\. Build and Scale the Full Customer Funnel
 



 Your ownership won't end once a campaign goes live.
 



 You will work across the full funnel:
 



**Discovery → Consideration → Conversion → Retention** 




 This includes:
 


* Building campaigns that drive awareness and discovery.
* Improving consideration through stronger propositions and product communication.
* Driving conversion through better offers, messaging and user experiences.
* Building lifecycle journeys across Push, WhatsApp and Email.
* Identifying high\-intent users and key drop\-offs.
* Designing interventions for cart abandoners, new users and repeat customers.



 The goal is simple:
 **continuously improve how users move through the funnel and drive measurable business growth.** 




  





 5\. Experiment, Learn and Scale
 



 You will have significant freedom to test ideas.
 



 We believe growth comes from running the right experiments—not waiting for the perfect answer.
 



 You will:
 


* Form hypotheses based on data and consumer insights.
* Design experiments across creatives, audiences, propositions, pricing, offers and funnels.
* Measure results and understand why something worked or didn't.
* Rapidly iterate and improve.
* Scale winning ideas into repeatable growth levers.



 We are looking for someone who enjoys asking,
 **"What happens if we try this?"** 
 —and then has the ownership to actually make it happen.
 



  





 6\. Run the Business, Not Just the Campaigns
 



 You will have direct visibility into business performance and will be expected to develop a strong understanding of the numbers behind growth.
 



 You will:
 


* Track metrics such as revenue, CAC, ROAS, CTR and CVR.
* Monitor daily and weekly business performance.
* Identify gaps, risks and opportunities before they become bigger problems.
* Build a strong understanding of the relationship between demand, inventory, pricing and growth.
* Work with Category and Operations teams to ensure growth plans are aligned with business realities.



 Over time, you should be able to look at the business, identify the biggest problem to solve, and drive the right intervention.
 



  





**What Will You Learn?** 




 This role is designed to give you
 **breadth of exposure and depth of ownership** 
 .
 



 You will learn how to:
 


* Build and scale a consumer/D2C brand.
* Think about growth as a business problem, not just a marketing problem.
* Run end\-to\-end GTM campaigns.
* Manage performance marketing hands\-on across major digital platforms.
* Use data and consumer insights to make decisions.
* Understand pricing, offers and conversion economics.
* Build lifecycle and retention journeys.
* Run experiments and make decisions based on results.
* Work across Product, Design, Analytics, Category and Operations.
* Take an idea from
 **0 → 1 → scale** 
 .



 Most importantly, you will develop the ability to
 **own a business problem end\-to\-end** 
 .
 



  





**Who Should Apply?** 




 We're looking for someone who wants more ownership than a typical marketing role offers.
 



 You will be a great fit if:
 


* You have 1–2 years of experience in growth, marketing, strategy, consulting, e\-commerce or a similar role.
* You want to own outcomes—not just tasks.
* You enjoy solving ambiguous problems and figuring things out from first principles.
* You are comfortable getting your hands dirty, whether that means analysing data, setting up a campaign or fixing an execution gap.
* You think in terms of business impact and enjoy understanding what drives revenue.
* You are analytical and comfortable using data to make decisions.
* You are highly detail\-oriented and don't let things fall through the cracks.
* You move fast, take initiative and have a strong
 **"get it done"** 
 mindset.
* You are excited by the idea of building something in a fast\-growing business.



 Experience in D2C, consumer internet, e\-commerce or marketing is a plus, but a strong ownership mindset matters more.
 



  





**What Can You Expect?** 



* **High Ownership from Day One**



 You will own meaningful growth problems and have the autonomy to figure out how to solve them.
 


* **Direct Business Impact**



 You will be able to see the direct impact of your work on revenue, growth and key business metrics.
 


* **Steep Learning Curve**



 You will get exposure to multiple aspects of building a D2C business—not just one narrow marketing function.
 


* **End\-to\-End Experience**



 You will take initiatives from insight and strategy through execution, measurement and scale.
 


* **Work Closely with Leadership**



 You will get visibility into how key business decisions are made and have the opportunity to influence them.
 


* **Build, Don't Just Maintain**



 You will work on new launches, campaigns, growth experiments and initiatives that help shape the future of Native.
 



  





 Location \& Work Setup
 


* **Location:** 
 Gurgaon
* **Work Mode:** 
 100% Work from Office

title: Brand Manager
description:
Position: Brand Manager
   

  

 Location: gurgaon
   

  

 ️ Working Days: Monday to Friday
   

  

 Experience Required: 4 to 6 years
   

  

 Brand Manager
   

  

*(Title is negotiable, we will fit it to the person instead of the other way around)*
 If you are the pink sheep in a world of black and whites, this one is yours.
   

  

 That is not a line on a wall here, it is how the work gets made. We would rather be argued with than agreed with, and we would rather be remembered than be safe.
   

  

**About Us**
 Our client is a new venture by a leading Indian consumer brand builder. We are in the business of building tasteful brands across categories and geographies. That could mean 0 to 1, 1 to 10, or 10 to 1000\. Six months in, we are about 25 people, each one here to do the best work of our lives.
   

  

 The founder did not build a leading consumer brand by making good products. He built it by understanding what a generation of Indians wanted to feel about themselves, and then making that buyable. We are doing that again, across more categories, for more kinds of Indians, from scratch.
   

  

 WHY WE ARE HIRING
   

  

 We need someone to run one of our brands. The brand is deeply rooted in South India. Its culture, its rituals, its everyday habits. The category it walks into has spent decades selling the past. Heritage, nostalgia, sepia, hand\-pounded, home\-style, authentic since 19\-whatever. Almost none of its language speaks to how people actually live and shop right now.
   

  

 We are building a culture\-first brand. A regional representation of taste, in the present tense, with a point of view. Rooted enough to carry real authority, current enough to sit in a 24\-year\-old’s cart without explaining itself.
   

  

 There will be a creative lead on this brand who owns what it looks like and sounds like. You own how to make the brand work. The plan, the portfolio, the money, the partners, the calendar, the shelf.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who already understands this market or can build a plan around it and execute end\-to\-end. More on the category and the brand once we are talking properly.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* The brand plan. What we launch, when, for whom, with what money. Annual on paper, quarterly in practice, and rewritten the moment the market says something different.
* The consumer. Who buys, who almost buys, and what makes someone switch after twenty years of buying the same thing. Some of that comes from data. Most of it comes from reginal learning.
* The portfolio. Pack sizes, price points, the SKU ladder, what launches and what gets killed. You bring the market back to product and supply chain as a point of view, not as a list of requests.
* Go to market. Launch sequence, city by city and channel by channel. Where we start, where we deliberately do not, and what has to be true before we widen.
* Channels. Quick commerce, marketplaces, modern trade, general trade, D2C. Listings, content, ratings, share of search, the merchandising calendar. A lot of this is unglamorous and it still decides the year.
* Media and budget. Where the money goes, what came back, what gets cut. You will defend a spend line, and you will also be the one to kill your own.
* The numbers. Awareness, trial, repeat, velocity per store, ROAS, share of search. You own the dashboard and you report it honestly, including the months it looks bad.
* Briefs. Written so a creative team can act on them. One problem, one real constraint, one thing to say. Then you get out of the way and let them make it better than the brief.
* Activations, brand partnerships, regional calendars. In this category, tasting beats telling, and you plan for that from day one.
* The cross\-functional mess. Founders, supply chain, sales, growth, product. A launch slips because packaging is stuck at a printer, and you are the person who knows that before anyone tells you.


**Cultural Fluency, What We Actually Mean**
* You truly believe the representation of South India by brands so far has been extremely surface level, and you can name the specific work that proves your point.
* You understand that the southern states are four different markets, not one segment. Different retail, different price expectations, different reasons to pick something up.
* You know which festivals move sales and which only move greetings.
* You are fluent in at least one South Indian language. Fluent enough to stand in a shop, ask a real question and follow the answer the shopkeeper gives the customer next to you.
* You can read a line of regional copy and tell whether it sounds like a person or like it went through Google Translate. And you push back when it is the latter.


 THIS IS FOR YOU IF
   

  

 A tidy deck and a media plan do not tell us much. We want someone with a point of view about this market and the numbers to argue it with. And is a go getter who runs the brand.
   

  

 Must have
   

  

* Three or more years in brand or marketing, with real ownership. A brand, a category or a launch that was actually yours.
* South Indian cultural fluency, exactly as described above.
* Comfort with numbers. You can build a plan, defend it line by line, and spot the month where it quietly stops making sense.
* Judgment on spend. Deciding what not to fund is the harder half of the job.
* You can write a brief a creative person actually wants to work on.
* Execution across levels. A pricing conversation at 11am, fixing a listing title or chasing a vendor at 8pm.
* Comfort with ambiguity. No playbook, and no category norms we intend to inherit.
* You can think without AI. Use the tools to move faster, never to think for you.


 Strongly preferred
   

  

* Food or FMCG background. You know packaging is the biggest media buy, that sampling converts, and roughly what FSSAI will and will not let you print on a pack.
* A 0 to 1 launch. You have taken something from nothing to on\-shelf, and you remember what broke.
* Quick commerce and marketplace depth. Listings, ads, assortment, share of search.
* Time inside a large FMCG system and time inside a startup. One taught you rigour, the other taught you speed.
* Real experience in southern markets. Distributors, trade, regional media, local creators.
* Experience managing agencies, vendors and a small team.


 And the quirks
   

  

* You know the difference between a brand that is famous and a brand that is bought, and you can name one of each.
* You read the back of packs in other people’s trolleys.
* There is a regional brand you admire that never ran a national campaign, and you know exactly why it worked.
* You hold strong opinions about a shelf you had nothing to do with.


 WHY JOIN
   

  

 Full ownership of a brand at a house of brands, from day zero. Direct access to one of the sharpest consumer brand builders in India. And the chance to build something rooted in a culture that most national brands still market to badly.

 We're hiring, on behalf of a fast\-growing, well\-funded AI revenue\-tech company, for a founding GTM Engineering Lead who will own their revenue engine from the ground up. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates.)
 



  





 The company is building an AI revenue workforce for high\-consideration sales, connecting the full journey from demand generation to buyer engagement, qualification, nurturing and sales handoff, with enterprise customers across India, the Middle East and the US.
 



  





 This is not a traditional sales\-ops role. You'll combine GTM strategy, data, automation, AI and experimentation to build a predictable outbound and revenue engine, from who to target down to the workflows that reach them and the dashboards that prove it's working.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* The end\-to\-end GTM engine across India and international markets: ICPs, segmentation, buyer personas, territories and prioritisation.
* Account intelligence built from real signals: launches, hiring, ad activity, funding, expansion and tech stack.
* Automated research, enrichment, lead scoring, personalisation, sequencing and routing, plus AI\-led workflows for prospecting, messaging, qualification and follow\-ups.
* Outbound across email, LinkedIn, calling and WhatsApp, working with sales to turn accounts into high\-quality meetings and fix funnel leakage.
* The full GTM stack (CRM, enrichment, sequencing, automation, analytics) and dashboards across meetings, opportunities, pipeline, geography, persona, source and revenue.



  





**Comfortable across the stack** 




 Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot/Salesforce, Instantly/Smartlead, Zapier/Make/n8n, enrichment APIs, and the craft behind them: APIs and webhooks, basic scripting/SQL, AI and LLM workflows, lead scoring and GTM analytics. You don't need to be a full\-time software engineer, but technical enough to build workflows yourself instead of waiting on an engineering team.
 



  





**What makes this role different** 




 You'll reason through questions most GTM hires never touch: Which accounts to target first, and what signals say an account has a strong need right now? Who are the 5–7 right stakeholders inside each company, and do you approach the CEO, CMO, VP Sales and Head of Digital differently? Which channels work in India vs UAE vs US? Which messaging is actually creating pipeline, and where are prospects leaking out of the funnel?
 



  





**A problem you might own** 




  





 A developer announces a new project in Dubai. You build a system that spots the launch, identifies the account, finds the relevant marketing and sales leaders, reads their tech stack and ad activity, enriches the contacts, generates the outreach, enrols them into the right sequence, and pings sales the moment buying intent shows up.
 



 Or: the company decides to target 2,000 companies in the US. You help decide which 2,000, which personas to reach, what triggers signal demand, which channels to prioritise, and how fast you can tell whether the market is working.
 



  





**You'll thrive here if you** 



* Think in systems, not one\-off campaigns.
* Like building from scratch, run many experiments, and kill what doesn't work.
* Move quickly between strategy and execution.
* Understand enterprise SaaS sales and enjoy working directly with founders.
* Want real ownership of a company's revenue engine.



  





**Why this is a founding role** 




 This is a founding team member position. You won't be slotting into someone else's playbook, you'll be writing it. The salary is highly competitive and comes with meaningful ESOPs, because the person building this revenue engine should own a real piece of what it becomes.
 



  




* If this is the system you want to build, I'd love to hear how you think about turning GTM into an engine. Apply here or DM us directly!

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Product Manager \- Growth** 
 to own a critical part of the Atlys growth engine and build product experiences that drive acquisition, activation, referrals and retention.
   

  

 You’ll define the product direction, understand what makes users convert and come back, identify growth opportunities, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and other teams to build experiments, growth loops, referral and rewards experiences that move key business metrics.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who can operate across
 **product strategy, growth and execution** 
 , navigate ambiguity, use data to make sharp decisions, and build product\-led experiences that scale across markets and customer segments.
   

  

**The Job**
* Own product strategy and roadmap for growth, defining priorities across acquisition, activation, engagement and retention based on customer behaviour, business impact and growth opportunities.
* Build product\-led growth loops by identifying opportunities across referrals, rewards, sharing, virality and network effects that drive organic user acquisition and repeat usage.
* Drive acquisition and conversion through experimentation, funnel optimisation and product improvements across landing experiences, onboarding, activation and core journeys.
* Build and scale growth programs across referrals, rewards, incentives and lifecycle experiences, using data and experimentation to improve CAC, conversion, engagement and retention.
* Lead cross\-functional execution by partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics and other teams to define growth bets, run experiments, make trade\-offs and ship quickly.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 2\-6 years of product management experience, ideally in consumer technology, fintech, travel, mobility or another high\-growth B2C environment.
* Have strong product judgment and a track record of owning growth\-focused product areas across acquisition, activation, referrals, rewards, engagement or retention.
* Are highly analytical and comfortable using data, experimentation and customer insights to identify growth levers and make product decisions.
* Understand product\-led growth and have experience building loops, incentives, referral programs or experiences that turn users into acquisition channels.
* Have strong ownership, prioritisation and execution skills, and can work effectively with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing and cross\-functional stakeholders.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Es Magico helps regulated enterprises move from AI experimentation to reliable, production\-grade Agentic AI systems. The company focuses on governance, integration, evaluation, and day\-to\-day operation, ensuring AI solutions stand up to regulatory, audit, and customer scrutiny. Its agentic suite, PYZO, uses reusable building blocks to turn institutional knowledge and SOPs into workflows, training, and large\-scale voice interactions, while integrating with existing systems. Es Magico primarily serves high\-stakes sectors such as BFSI, healthcare, and the public sector, closing the gap between promising pilots and robust, compliant deployments. The team has delivered dependable AI outcomes for more than eighteen regulated enterprises, translating AI ambition into measurable enterprise value.
   

**Role Description** 
 As a Product Manager at Es Magico, you will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI products built on PYZO, from problem definition and discovery to launch and continuous improvement. You will work closely with customers in regulated industries to understand their operational, compliance, and user experience needs, translating them into clear product requirements and roadmaps. You will collaborate with engineering, data, design, and operations teams to prioritize features, manage releases, and ensure solutions are reliable, governed, and production\-ready. You will track product performance, gather feedback, and make data\-informed decisions to refine workflows, agent capabilities, and integrations over time. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, requiring regular collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders and occasional engagements with client teams.
   

**Qualifications**
* Product management skills, including roadmap planning, requirements definition, stakeholder alignment, and release management.
* Experience with AI, data\-driven products, or complex software systems, ideally in regulated environments such as BFSI, healthcare, or public sector.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with comfort using metrics, experiments, and user feedback to guide decisions.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear narratives for diverse audiences.
* Background in working closely with engineering and design teams to ship production\-grade, customer\-facing products.
* Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance considerations in enterprise technology implementations is highly beneficial.
* Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives, prioritize under constraints, and deliver outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.

You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact by transforming business requirements into effective, scalable solutions.

* Coordinate and support implementation and management of our People systems and related internal tools.


* Train end users and create collateral to target audiences

* Manage and support release cycles, including analyzing new features and advising People Team leaders and functional SMEs on potential benefits and considerations.
