* 5\-7 years of experience in an HRIS, People technology, or related Program Management role.


* Demonstrated ability to own and deliver cross\-functional projects from start to finish, influencing peers and stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.


* Sought out for your ability to resolve ambiguity and proactively identify and solve complex problems before they escalate.


* Experience acting as an autonomous owner of project deliverables and mentoring junior team members.


* Strong experience with a major HCM platform and a deep understanding of core HR business processes.


* Proven ability to translate business needs into functional requirements and system specifications.


* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted and influential voice in planning discussions.


* Must be able to work flexible hours to ensure overlap with the U.S. Eastern time zone.



**Desired Skills and Attributes**

  
 



* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.


* A collaborative team player with a passion for learning and continuous improvement.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Product Engineer (Field Tools)
description:
****Starting Date:****
 December 2026
   

  

****Contract type:****
 Full\-time and open\-ended
   

  

****Salary:****
 From 2,716,737 INR
   

  

****Location:****
 India; Delhi, Ahmedabad (Hybrid)
   

  

****Application closing date:****
 8th October 2026
   

  

**If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.**
**About The Job**
 The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.
   

  

****The Challenge****
 Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will be responsible for :
   

  

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.


**Experience**
 the following skills, knowledge, and experience:
   

  

**Essential**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.


**Desirable**
* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.


**What We Offer**
* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.


****Working arrangements****
 The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.
   

  

****Apply now****
 Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before
 ****08\.10\.2026****
 via the application link.
   

  

 In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.
   

  

 Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.
   

  

****Our hiring process****
**Initial Screening**
 Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.
   

  

**Interviews**
 If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.
   

  

**Assessment And Testing**
 Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.
   

  

**Reference Checks**
 Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.
   

  

**Offer Stage**
 After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.
   

  

**About Better Cotton Initiative**
 Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.
   

  

**About Our Values**
 The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:
   

  

* Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
* Positive (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* Daring (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)


****Being you @ Better Cotton****
****Initiative****
 Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.
   

  

 We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager — Internal Performance Dashboard** 




  





**Company** 
 : SMC Global Securities Ltd.
 



**Function** 
 : Product Management / Internal Platforms
 



**Location** 
 : New Delhi NCR (on\-site)
 



**Experience** 
 : 3–6 years
 



 \-\-\-
 



**About the role** 




 SMC's internal performance dashboard is the system of record for how the business sees itself
 



 — revenue, brokerage, client acquisition, branch and franchise productivity, and RM\-level
 



 performance. Leadership, regional heads, branch managers, Authorised Persons and franchise
 



 partners all look at the same numbers through it, each with a different slice of access.
 



 We are looking for a Product Manager to own this platform end to end: what gets measured,
 



 who sees it, how fast it loads, and whether the person looking at it can act on what they see.
 



 This is an internal product, which means your users sit in the same building and will tell you
 



 exactly what is broken. It also means every number on the screen is one a business head will
 



 make a decision on.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 \- Product roadmap for the dashboard — define quarterly priorities across reporting modules,
 



 drilldowns, exports and alerting, balancing leadership asks against platform debt.
 



 \- Metric definitions and data contracts — work with Finance, Business and Engineering to agree
 



 what each metric means, at what grain, with what refresh cadence, and keep those definitions
 



 stable and documented. Ambiguity here is the single biggest source of trust loss in a
 



 performance dashboard.
 



 \- Role\-based access design — specify entitlement models across Admin, Regional Head, RM,
 



 Branch, Franchisee and Authorised Person roles, so each user sees their own hierarchy and
 



 nothing beyond it.
 



 \- Requirement documentation — write clear PRDs, user journeys, acceptance criteria and edge\-
 



 case matrices that engineering and QA can build and test against without a follow\-up meeting.
 



 \- UAT and release management — plan and run UAT cycles with business stakeholders, triage
 



 defects with QA, sign off releases, and publish structured release notes (What's New, User
 



 Journey, Notes) to the user base.
 



 \- Stakeholder management — run recurring reviews with business heads, collect and prioritise
 



 change requests, and push back with reasoning when a request will not survive contact with the
 



 data.
 



 \- Data accuracy and reconciliation — establish checks that catch mismatches between the
 



 dashboard and source systems before a user does, and own the resolution loop when they
 



 surface.
 



 \- Adoption and usage — track who actually logs in, which reports get used, where users drop
 



 off, and close the gap between what was built and what gets opened.
 



  





**What you need** 




 \- 3–6 years in product management, business analysis or product\-facing delivery, with at least 2
 



 years on data, reporting or analytics products.
 



 \- Working knowledge of Indian capital markets — broking revenue models, brokerage and DP
 



 income, franchise and Authorised Person structures, client acquisition funnels. Prior experience
 



 at a broker, AMC, exchange, depository participant or fintech is strongly preferred.
 



 \- Strong SQL. You should be able to pull and validate numbers yourself rather than filing a ticket
 



 to find out whether a figure is wrong.
 



 \- Demonstrated ability to write precise specifications — PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria,
 



 RBAC matrices.
 



 \- Experience running UAT with non\-technical business stakeholders and converting vague
 



 feedback into scoped work.
 



 \- Comfort with BI and visualisation tooling (Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Superset or
 



 equivalent) and an eye for when a chart is lying.
 



 \- Clear written communication. Much of this role is documentation that other people depend on.
 



  





**Good to have** 




 \- Exposure to data warehousing concepts, ETL pipelines and reporting\-layer performance
 



 tuning.
 



 \- Familiarity with SEBI and exchange reporting obligations and how audit and compliance
 



 requirements shape internal reporting.
 



 \- Understanding of authentication and access controls appropriate to financial systems,
 



 including the limits of OTP\-based auth and the case for SSO or MFA on sensitive dashboards.
 



 \- Experience with dashboard UX — information hierarchy, drilldown patterns, mobile\-readable
 



 reporting.
 



 \- Basic front\-end literacy (HTML/CSS) sufficient to prototype a layout and communicate intent to
 



 designers and developers.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
We're building a new product team in India to help shape how customers build, deploy, and operate AI applications on MongoDB. This is an early hire on a growing team—you'll join while the team is still taking shape, with the opportunity to have real impact from the start.
   

  

 You'll report to a Director of Product Management based in Europe, working async\-first with partners across India, EMEA, and North America. The engineering team in India is being built in parallel, so you'll be working closely with engineers from the early days of the team.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

 You'll be the end\-to\-end owner for a core area of our AI application platform—from discovery and vision through roadmap, delivery, and iteration. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through ownership, expertise, and cross\-functional influence.
   

  

 Day to day, that means
   

  

* Defining product strategy and roadmap for your area, aligned with MongoDB's broader AI strategy and business goals
* Talking to customers — from AI\-native startups to large enterprises — to understand how they build and deploy AI applications, where they struggle, and what MongoDB should do about it
* Writing clear product narratives, memos, and specs that align stakeholders, clarify trade\-offs, to guide conversations with engineering, design, product marketing, etc
* Partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders—including Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Partners, Sales, and Developer Relations—to scope, prioritize, and ship, balancing experimentation with reliability and scale, and driving positioning, launches, and enablement
* Identifying new opportunities autonomously—spotting gaps, shaping problem spaces, researching industry trends and running discovery sessions with customers
* Define and own clear success metrics for your area and use them to prioritize, make trade\-offs and communicate impact


 You'll develop deep expertise in how companies build AI applications — including agentic workflows, retrieval and memory, evaluation, observability, and deployment patterns.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

* Async\-first. Documentation and written communication are how decisions travel across time zones
* Sync when it makes sense. When we need to discuss something live, we hop on a call to unbundle issues together.
* In\-person when it matters. The team gets together periodically for planning, relationship\-building, and the kind of work that's better done face to face


 What you'll bring
   

  

* 5\+ years in product management (or equivalent) building platforms, infrastructure, or developer\-facing products — ideally in cloud, data, or AI
* Proven end\-to\-end ownership of a product area: from framing the problem and vision through roadmap, execution, launch, and iteration
* Customer obsession: you're comfortable running discovery calls, digging into workflows, and turning messy feedback into clear product decisions
* Strong written and live communication: clear docs, productive meetings, confident stakeholder presentations. This matters more in an async, distributed team — writing is how you lead
* Technical depth sufficient to collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems, cloud services, and AI/ML tooling, and to ask good questions when something is unclear
* Curiosity about AI: you follow how companies are building AI applications — agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG, fine\-tuning, or other emerging patterns
* Comfort with ambiguity: you help define the problem, the success metrics, and the path forward. In an early\-stage team, this is the job


 Bonus points
   

  

* Experience building developer tools, AI platforms, or MLOps/LLMOps products
* Engineering background or deep experience partnering with engineering on technical products
* Experience with enterprise customers on mission\-critical workloads
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Figma Make) to move faster and amplify impact


 How we'll measure success (30/60/90 days)
   

  

 We need someone who can onboard quickly and start driving impact early.
   

  

 In your first 30 days, you will:
   

  

* Ramp up on MongoDB products, AI application patterns, and how our teams work
* Shadow customer calls and internal forums to learn current strategy, open questions, and key stakeholders
* Produce a clear written overview of your product area: current state, key bets, and known gaps


 By 60 days, you will
   

  

* Take ownership of a set of customer relationships and run your own discovery conversations each week
* Own and socialize an initial strategy and roadmap proposal for your area, with clear problem statements and success metrics
* Partner with engineering and design to shape and drive at least one scoped initiative into execution


 By 90 days, you will
   

  

* Be the go\-to owner for your product area, driving prioritization and day\-to\-day decision\-making across functions
* Lead customer\- and data\-informed iterations on what you’ve shipped, adjusting the roadmap based on what you’re learning
* Contribute to the broader AI application platform strategy with perspectives from your domain, customers, and the field


 Why this role
   

  

 MongoDB is one of the most widely adopted database platforms in the world, used by tens of thousands of customers — including much of the Fortune 100 and a fast\-growing set of AI\-native startups. Our cloud platform, Atlas, runs across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.
   

  

 This role puts you at the center of how MongoDB powers AI applications at scale. You’ll own a critical slice of that story, from strategy through delivery and adoption.
   

  

**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Actimize Product Engineer III (L10\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony’s
 **AML Engineering Organization** 
 is focused on building and maintaining technology solutions that help detect, monitor, and prevent financial crime across the enterprise.
   

  

 The team develops scalable platforms that support AML surveillance, case management, regulatory reporting, data integration, and risk\-based monitoring.
   

  

 We partner closely with Compliance, Risk, Data Science, Product, and Operations teams to deliver reliable and effective AML capabilities.
   

  

 Our engineers leverage modern software engineering, automation, analytics, and cloud\-native practices to improve detection accuracy and operational efficiency.
   

  

 By combining regulatory awareness with strong engineering discipline, AML Engineering helps protect Synchrony, its customers, and the broader financial ecosystem.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking a highly skilled AML Product Engineer to join our team and take ownership of the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) products. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software engineering combined with a deep understanding of AML regulations and product functionality. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams including compliance, data science, and product management to build effective AML solutions that help detect and prevent financial crimes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain AML product features and modules ensuring scalability, reliability, and compliance with regulatory standards.
* Document AML Data mapping from Source to AML
* Collaborate with compliance and risk teams to translate AML rules and regulatory requirements into technical specifications.
* Implement and optimize transaction monitoring systems, alert generation mechanisms, case management tools, and customer risk scoring features.
* Integrate AML product solutions with internal and external data sources, including sanctions lists, watchlists, and transaction data feeds.
* Continuously improve AML product performance through data analysis, tuning detection algorithms, and refining workflows.
* Work closely with data scientists and analysts to implement machine learning models and analytics for enhanced detection of suspicious activities.
* Provide technical troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and swift resolution of AML product issues.
* Ensure AML product security, data privacy, and audit readiness.
* Support product QA, user acceptance testing (UAT), and participate in release management.
* Keep abreast of evolving AML regulations, industry trends, and emerging technologies to innovate product capabilities.
* Document system designs, processes, and code in accordance with company standards.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems.
* Minimum 3\+ years in software engineering with a focus on financial crime, AML, or regulatory technology products.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, Python, or C\#.
* 2\-5 years of experience with AML software platforms (e.g., Actimize, SAS, NICE, or equivalent) is a must.
* Knowledge of AML regulatory requirements (e.g., BSA, FATF, OFAC sanctions) and risk typologies.
* Familiarity with transaction monitoring systems, alert workflows, case management, and KYC/CDD processes.
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), APIs, and integration of external data services.
* Understanding of machine learning/AI applications in AML is preferred.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Exposure to Actimize SAM and CDD modules.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities combined with a proactive and solution\-focused mindset.
* Ability to mentor and uplift the capabilities of peers in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment.
* Critical thinking, creativity, and a solution\-driven mindset
* Exposure to ETL tools like Ab initio.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 Minimum 4\+ years of experience with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems.
   

  

**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**

title: Production Merchandiser
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Merchandising \& Product Management** 




 ·      Own the complete product merchandising cycle from product development and sampling to production and final dispatch.
 



 ·      Plan and execute the merchandising calendar in line with business and sales requirements.
 



 ·      Ensure timely development, approval, and execution of products/styles.
 



 ·      Monitor product and style status and provide regular updates to senior management.
 



 ·      Identify potential delays and proactively drive corrective actions.
 



**2\. Vendor Management \& Negotiation** 




 ·      Manage and develop strong relationships with domestic and international vendors/factories.
 



 ·      Lead negotiations on price, MOQ, quality, lead time, payment terms, and delivery schedules.
 



 ·      Evaluate vendor performance and identify opportunities for improving cost, quality, and delivery.
 



 ·      Ensure vendors comply with agreed commercial and operational requirements.
 



 ·      Resolve vendor\-related issues and production escalations effectively.
 



**3\. Costing \& Commercial Management** 




 ·      Lead product costing and commercial discussions with vendors and the production team.
 



 ·      Review costing and ensure competitive pricing before seeking management approval.
 



 ·      Drive cost optimization through effective negotiation, sourcing, and vendor management.
 



 ·      Monitor purchase costs and identify opportunities for improving margins and overall business efficiency.
 



**4\. Procurement \& Order Execution** 




 ·      Oversee the generation and accuracy of Purchase Orders, Item Masters, Buy Forms, and PTRs.
 



 ·      Ensure purchase orders are released within defined timelines.
 



 ·      Monitor order execution from confirmation to production and dispatch.
 



 ·      Ensure product requirements, quantities, specifications, and timelines are accurately communicated to vendors.
 



**5\. Production \& Shipment Coordination** 




 ·      Monitor production progress through regular PTR and production tracking.
 



 ·      Coordinate with vendors/factories to resolve production\-related issues and ensure timely completion.
 



 ·      Coordinate with Production, Sales, Quality, Shipping, and Documentation teams for smooth execution.
 



 ·      Ensure approved shipments are dispatched as per committed timelines.
 



 ·      Track shipment readiness and proactively escalate potential delays.

 ·      Lead, manage, and mentor the merchandising team.
 



 ·      Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance and deliverables.
 



 ·      Establish clear timelines, priorities, and accountability within the team.

 ·      Prepare and present regular merchandising MIS and business updates to senior management.
 



 ·      Track key parameters including order status, production progress, vendor performance, costing, and shipment timelines.
 



 ·      Highlight critical business risks, delays, and dependencies with proposed action plans.
 



 ·      Maintain accurate and updated product/style trackers and ensure timely reporting.
 



**Key Requirements** 




 ·      7–10\+ years of relevant experience in Product Merchandising / Apparel / Retail / Procurement.
 



 ·      Proven experience in managing the complete merchandising and product execution cycle.
 



 ·      Strong experience in vendor management, commercial negotiations, costing, sourcing, and production management.
 



 ·      Prior experience in team handling and mentoring.
 



 ·      Strong knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and merchandising MIS.
 



 ·      Strong understanding of product development, sampling, procurement, production, and shipment processes.
 



 ·      Excellent negotiation, communication, analytical, and decision\-making skills.
 



 ·      Ability to manage multiple vendors, products, and critical timelines simultaneously.
 



 ·      Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional coordination skills.
 



 ·      Ability to work independently, manage escalations, and provide effective solutions.

title: Market Engagement Manager, SheConnects Digital Accelerator
description:
**Location:** 
 Delhi
   

  

**Position type:** 
*Fixed Term Contract until March 31, 2028*
**What The Hiring Manager Says**
 “Working across India and Africa, this role is a great opportunity for someone with a strong commercial background who is also passionate about driving digital inclusion for underserved groups, especially women. As Market Engagement Manager, you will collaborate closely with partners to drive strategic interventions focused on increasing internet adoption and use. You’ll help create scalable and impactful solutions that can drive long\-term change for women and underserved populations.”
   

  

*Adrine Muhura – Senior Market Engagement Manager, M4D*
**About The Team**
 GSMA Mobile for Development (M4D) is a dedicated global team within the GSMA, which brings together our mobile operator members, tech innovators, the development community and governments, to realise the impact of mobile in low\- and middle\-income countries:
   

  

 This role is part of he SheConnects Digital Accelerator which was founded by the Reliance Foundation and Gates Foundation to advance women’s digital inclusion. The Accelerator aims to scale proven, high\-impact solutions that enable women and girls to participate fully in the digital world, improving their lives and livelihoods. The Accelerator grants are supported by Reliance Foundation in India and by Gates Foundation in Sub Saharan Africa. By catalysing innovative partnerships and use cases, the Accelerator will strengthen evidence on what works, foster south\-to\-south learning, and help shape a more inclusive global digital ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will work as part of the team to support the scale up of approaches to increase women’s adoption and use of the internet, reducing the gender gap.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include working as part of a team to:
   

  

- Support a portfolio of partners across Africa and India interested in accelerating women’s adoption and use of the internet, with a particular focus on increasing smartphone ownership and use. This will include managing and delivering technical assistance and advisory support to organisations being supported by the initiative to help drive and scale impactful in\-country actions. This includes:

* Ensuring effective contracting and management of packages of technical assistance and provisioning strategic advisory support.
* Providing thought leadership, analysing market opportunities, inputting to the design and delivery of propositions, creating and delivering strategy workshops for partners, and tracking both commercial and social outcomes.
* Generate and share key insights which drive increased awareness and action among stakeholders as well as supporting knowledge exchange between partners. This includes documenting insights and learnings and sharing your findings with the industry ecosystem through presentations, case studies, toolkits, blogs, events and meetings with relevant stakeholders.


**About You**
 You will have a strong commercial experience, gained through working as a management consultant or within corporate strategy, business planning or marketing functions, ideally within or for the digital sector.
   

  

 You have familiarity with strategies that drive inclusion for underserved communities, including women. This will ideally include knowledge and understanding of approaches to improving handset affordability and adoption.
   

  

 You can quickly understand new data and business models to identify commercial opportunities that can also have a substantial social impact when successfully scaled.
   

  

 You will be confident and comfortable presenting to and engaging with senior leadership in the private sector, quick to identify insights and summarise key points.
   

  

 You are compelling and persuasive and can draw on GSMA and other insights to add value to partners and provide evidence to drive sustainable action.
   

  

 You have strong verbal and written communication skills and can document insights and learnings to share your findings with the industry ecosystem
   

  

 You are a strong team player, self\-aware and able to work collaboratively by default, supporting others and knowing when to reach out for support yourself.
   

  

 You have strong project management skills and organised to deliver high impact outputs.
   

  

 You will be passionate about the transformative potential of the internet and digital services to improve women’s livelihoods, economic security and resilience.
   

  

**About Your Skills**
**Communication** 
 – Critical for influence, credibility, and impact. This role requires the ability to distil market insights, data, and partner learnings into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with senior decision\-makers across the private sector, governments, donors, and the broader digital inclusion ecosystem. Strong written and verbal communication and thought leadership that shape industry discourse and drive action.
   

  

**Delivery** 
 – Essential for translating strategy into execution. The role demands strong project and delivery management skills to oversee multiple workstreams simultaneously, ensure effective contracting and management of technical assistance, and deliver high\-impact outputs on time and to quality. Delivery capability ensures that partner engagements result in tangible commercial and social outcomes.
   

  

**Influence** 
 – Central to driving behaviour change and sustainable action among diverse stakeholders. This skill enables the role to persuade and align senior leaders within mobile operators, ecosystem partners, and GSMA internal teams around evidence\-based recommendations. Influence is critical to positioning insights as actionable, building momentum for scale, and embedding strategies to advance women's digital inclusion.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 – Fundamental to the success of the program. This role requires the ability to build, manage, and maintain trusted relationships with senior executives, mobile operators, enabling organisations, donors, and internal teams. Effective stakeholder management supports collaboration across geographies and sectors, balances differing incentives, and ensures alignment between commercial objectives and inclusion goals.
   

  

**Commercial Awareness** 
 – Strong commercial acumen enables the identification of market opportunities that can drive both business value and social impact, particularly in areas such as smartphone affordability, adoption, and usage. This skill ensures that recommendations are grounded in realistic business models, market dynamics, and partner priorities, strengthening the credibility and long\-term sustainability of digital interventions.
   

  

**Contract type**
 Fixed Term Contract (Fixed Term)
   

  

**Worker type**
 Employee
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast\-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry\-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.
   

  

 In addition to architect\-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning \& development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.
   

  

 To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.
   

  

 Being You at the GSMA
   

  

 We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well\-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi\-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.
   

  

**GSMA Values**
 Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.
   

  

**Passionately driven**
 We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world\-changing impact.
   

  

**Insightful leaders**
 We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.
   

  

**Stronger together**
 We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.
   

  

 Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

**About Avataar Skincare:** 




  





 We are an innovative and fast\-growing skincare startup revolutionizing the industry with personalized, high\-quality at\-home aesthetic solutions. We offer a wide range of services, including advanced laser treatments, anti\-aging solutions,and hair restoration, using cutting\-edge techniques like laser hair reduction, medi\-facials, and GLP\-1 therapies.
 



  





 Backed by Peak XV's Spark program (formerly Sequoia Capital India) and featured on Shark Tank, we've secured investments from top sharks like Aman Gupta (boAt) and Anupam Mittal (Shaadi.com). Our at\-home services live in 18 cities across India, and we're also building a state of the art, AI\-powered skincare platform that delivers personalized,holistic solutions to tackle our customers’ unique beauty needs.
 



  





 With 3X growth in the past year, we have touched \~30 Cr ARR, and have a goal to reach 100 Cr ARR in the next 12 months– offering exciting opportunities for individuals passionate about the startup ecosystem. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are eager to solve challenges in consumer services and tech, Avataar is the place to be!

 Help improve operational processes and internal workflows, ensuring efficiency across the organization.

 Conduct market research and competitive analysis to assist in the formulation of strategic business decisions and expansion plans.
 



  





  





**Qualifications \& Requirements:** 




  





**· Experience:** 
 2\-3 years of work experience with top consulting firms such as McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Kearney, Strategy\&, Roland Berger, or Accenture Strategy with a focus on management consulting, strategy, or business operations.
 



  





**· Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
 



  





**· Analytical Skills:** 
 Strong ability to analyze data, develop insights, and present actionable recommendations.

**· Leadership \& Initiative:** 
 Proven ability to take ownership of projects, manage deadlines, and drive results.
 



  





**· Organizational Skills:** 
 Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects, and work under pressure.
 



  





**· Problem\-Solving:** 
 Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills, with a proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.
 



  





 ·
 **Confidentiality:** 
 Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
 



  





  





**Perks \& Benefits:**

 **High\-Impact Role:** 
 Work closely with the Founder and leadership team to influence the strategic direction of the company.
 



  





 ·
 **Growth Opportunity:** 
 Exceptional opportunity to grow within a rapidly expanding company with potential for leadership roles.
 



  





**· Dynamic Work Environment:** 
 A fast\-paced, dynamic work environment where no two days are the same.
 



  





**· Competitive Compensation:** 
 Attractive salary and benefits package.

With production houses in Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, Nudge Asia is able to move seamlessly from ideation to end\-to\-end execution.  ✨ Ability to manage teams and multiple projects under tight deadlines
 



 ✨ Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills
 



 ✨ A hands\-on approach with strong ownership and accountability
 



 ✨ Willingness to travel and work on\-ground whenever required

title: Program Director, Agriculture, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description:
**About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)**
 We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence \- presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
   

  

 Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI\-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low\- and middle\-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3\.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open\-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI\-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
   

  

* Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M\+ farmers with AI\-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R\&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM\-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change.
* Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI\-enabled clinical decision support to 20M\+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low\-resource settings, including direct\-to\-consumer (DTC) health interventions.


 We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long\-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M\+ people with cost\-effective, evidence\-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last\-mile delivery.
   

  

**About 2AI India And EAII Advisors**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
 The Program Director for Agriculture is the domain expert and relationship anchor for 2AI's first India program area. Agriculture is where 2AI India starts, beginning with AI\-enabled weather forecasting and advisory services for smallholder farmers, with potential to expand into adjacent interventions over time. This person brings both substantive knowledge of the Indian agriculture sector and a network across government, research, and implementing organizations that can be activated quickly to accelerate program design and partnership development.
   

  

 This is a founding role, which means it is not only a strategy and relationships job. At this stage, everyone executes. We are looking for someone genuinely energized by what AI can do for farmers, who brings opinions and hypotheses rather than only process, and who is not so tied to any one institution's approach that it limits our ability to build something new.
   

  

**Program Strategy and Design**
* Owns the strategy and multi\-year plan for 2AI India's agriculture portfolio, and translates it into annual workplans with milestones and owners
* Designs and oversees pilots across dissemination channels and intervention types, each with a clear learning agenda agreed with the Evidence Lead
* Identifies which AI\-enabled interventions are worth pursuing in the Indian context, forms a view on why, and revises it as evidence accumulates


**Government and Partner Relationships**
* Builds and holds trusted relationships with national and state agriculture departments, relevant central ministries, meteorological agencies, and agricultural universities and research institutions
* Anticipates the needs of government counterparts while holding partnerships accountable to delivery commitments, and shows understanding of how policy decisions actually get made
* Manages relationships with partners in implementation, research, technology, and AI labs, coordinating them toward a coherent program rather than a set of parallel projects
* Represents 2AI India's agriculture work externally, including to funders and in sector forums


**Hands\-On Execution**
* Does the early operational and analytical work personally. This is a founding\-team role with a limited delegation layer underneath it.
* Works with the Associate Director, Program Operations to translate program design into action at the state level, bringing deep knowledge of state level realities to program strategy and management


**Team Building**
* Recruits, coaches, and manages the agriculture team as it grows, including state\-level and field staff, and sets the performance standard for it
* Builds a team culture that connects to 2AI globally, not only to the India office
* Fosters a strong, values\-aligned culture as a leader across the organization
* Willingness to roll\-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding team


**Disclaimer:** 
 The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Essentials**
* Relevant professional background: 10\-12 years of experience in agriculture, rural development, or a closely adjacent field, with a track record of scaling programs to reach large numbers of farmers.
* Deep sector knowledge: real depth in Indian smallholder agriculture, including farmer contexts, state\-level agricultural systems in more than one state, relevant government ministries, and the ecosystem of implementing organizations and research institutions.
* Building \& maintaining relationships: brings an established network across government, research, and implementation in Indian agriculture, and has also succeeded in forging new relationships rather than only maintaining inherited ones. Uses discretion, reads the policy decision process accurately at both state and central levels, and is trusted
* Strategic thinking: sees the gap before it is named, and can hold an ambitious direction and a realistic view of constraints at the same time. Moves between operational detail and portfolio\-level logic without losing either
* Experience standing up a new program, venture, or state operation from scratch
* Forward\-looking on AI: genuinely energized by what AI can do for farmers, current on what is actually working, and motivated to figure out what that looks like in the Indian context. Brings hypotheses, not just processes
* Builder instincts: Experience standing up a new program, venture, or state operation from scratch. Low ego, no task too small, and willing to do the operational and analytical work personally at this stage
* People management: has built teams that were cohesive, motivated, and mission\-driven, and can point to people who grew under them
* Clear communication: translates technical information into common language, and writes and presents compellingly for government, funder, and technical audiences
* Comfort with ambiguity: thrives in high\-growth scenarios, adjusts quickly to shifting timelines and priorities, and is comfortable with a direction that may change every three to six months in the near term


**What Success Looks Like**
**In the First 6 Months:**
* You are implementing a program strategy for agriculture you co\-designed with the 2AI India Country Director, with clear prioritization, milestones, and ongoing learnings incorporated via quick feedback loops
* At least one substantive state or central government relationship has moved from introduction to an active working conversation about delivery
* A first pilot or design partnership is scoped, with a learning agenda agreed with the Evidence Lead, and you know what would cause you to stop it
* You have hired, or supported the Associate Director, Program Operations in hiring, the capacity the program needs at both the national and state level during it's initial launch and scale\-up


**Compensation**
 Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
   

  

**Benefits**
 EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Generous leave
* Mental and physical wellbeing benefits
* Learning \& Development benefits
* Avenues for engagement and recognition


**Note: This role will be open for applications until 9 October 2026\.** 
 Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

title: AVP, Senior Product Engineer (L10)
description:
**Role Title:** 
 AVP, Senior Product Engineer (L10\)
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony Engineering’s
 **Application \& Enterprise Architecture (A\&EA)** 
 organization provides the architectural leadership and governance needed to design, evolve, and simplify Synchrony’s technology landscape. A\&EA partners with product, engineering, security, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure that solutions are
 **business\-aligned, scalable, secure, resilient, and cost\-effective** 
 , while reducing complexity and accelerating delivery.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The
 **AVP, Senior Product Engineer** 
 is responsible for administering, supporting, troubleshooting, and optimizing SAS Viya environments deployed on AWS and Kubernetes (Amazon EKS). This role requires strong expertise in SAS Viya platform administration, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes operations, Terraform\-based infrastructure as code, security, authentication, and enterprise system integrations.
   

  

 The position plays a critical role in ensuring platform stability, performance, scalability, and security while supporting modernization and migration initiatives from SAS 9\.4/Grid to SAS Viya 4\.0\. The administrator will collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, IAM, network, database, and application teams to deliver reliable enterprise analytics platform services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The role involves end\-to\-end operational ownership of SAS Viya 4 environments and associated AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure components.
   

  

* Administer and support SAS Viya 4 environments in enterprise production settings.
* Perform platform configuration, upgrades, patching, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance.
* Manage SAS Viya services, compute environments, CAS, SAS Studio, users, groups, roles, and authorization controls.
* Troubleshoot application, compute, storage, and performance issues within SAS Viya.
* Support and manage SAS Viya deployments on Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.
* Investigate and resolve issues related to pods, deployments, services, persistent volumes, storage, nodes, resource limits, and application logs.
* Configure and troubleshoot integrations between SAS Viya and AWS services including EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, and VPC components.
* Manage IAM roles, policies, service accounts, permissions, and cross\-account accessrequirements.
* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Terraform\-based infrastructure as code for cloud resources and platform deployments.
* Create and manage Terraform modules, variables, plans, state files, and deployment workflows.
* Configure and support enterprise authentication and SSO integrations using Okta, SAML, LDAP/Active Directory, OAuth/OIDC, or similar technologies.
* Troubleshoot authentication, MFA, authorization, SSO, and role\-mapping issues.
* Support platform security requirements including certificates, TLS/SSL, networking, and connectivity.
* Perform performance tuning, capacity planning, and optimization across CPU, memory, storage, and I/O layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Terraform, Python, Shell, and SAS scripting.
* Support migration activities from SAS 9\.4/Grid to SAS Viya 4\.
* Collaborate with AWS, Security, IAM, Network, Database, and Application teams to ensure seamless platform operations.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
 Candidates must demonstrate strong technical depth across SAS Viya administration, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
   

  

* 6\+ years of experience in SAS Administration.
* Hands\-on experience administering SAS Viya 4 environments.
* Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, S3, Lambda and VPC.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes concepts including Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVC/PV, Storage Classes, and resource management.
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon EKS.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Experience with enterprise authentication technologies such as Okta, SAML, OAuth, SSO, MFA, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of LDAP/Active Directory and role\-based access control.
* Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience with SAS Viya monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Python and Shell scripting for automation.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
 The ideal candidate will bring a combination of strong technical capability, operational discipline, and collaboration skills to support a modern enterprise analytics platform.
   

  

* Experience with SAS 9\.4 Grid/SAS Viya 4 administration.
* SAS Viya or AWS certification.
* Exposure to Helm, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, or CI/CD tools and practices.
* Experience with AWS Glue, Redshift, Snowflake, or other cloud data platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments and cloud migration projects.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams in infrastructure, security, and application domains.
* Proactive approach to automation, optimization, and operational improvement.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 6\-10 Years of Total experience, 3\-4 years of SAS Viya Administration, and 2\-3 years of AWS experience, having hood hands\-on and knowledge in Terraform/DevOps/Jenkins.


**Work Timings: 2 pm to 11 pm IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**
* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (Formal/Final Formal)
* L8\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible to apply for this opportunity.
* L8\+ Employees can apply.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 As a Product Manager at Nitro Commerce, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle—from identifying customer and market opportunities to defining, building, launching, and continuously improving products and features.
 



 You will build solutions that help e\-commerce and D2C brands accelerate growth, reduce customer acquisition costs, improve retention and revenue, and scale their businesses sustainably.
 



 You will act as the voice of the customer and the connective tissue across engineering, design, marketing, sales, customer success, and growth teams. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in ambiguity, moves with urgency, makes data\-informed decisions, and demonstrates strong product ownership and commercial understanding.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Product Strategy \& Vision
 


* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with Nitro Commerce’s business objectives and long\-term mission.
* Identify opportunities across commerce, growth, advertising, payments, loyalty, and marketing technology.
* Evaluate market trends, customer needs, and competitive developments to identify areas for innovation.
* Prioritize initiatives by balancing customer impact, business value, technical feasibility, and available resources.



 User \& Market Research
 


* Develop a deep understanding of e\-commerce and D2C customers, their challenges, workflows, and growth goals.
* Gather qualitative and quantitative insights through customer conversations, market research, competitive analysis, and product data.
* Validate product hypotheses through prototypes, pilots, experiments, and A/B testing.
* Build and maintain strong domain expertise across customer acquisition, retention, loyalty, payments, advertising, and marketing technology.



 Product Planning \& Execution
 


* Translate customer problems and business opportunities into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with design and UX teams to create intuitive workflows and user experiences.
* Lead product execution across the development lifecycle, including sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and delivery tracking.
* Make informed trade\-offs between scope, speed, quality, and technical complexity.
* Ensure products are delivered on time while maintaining a high bar for usability, reliability, and scalability.



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, data, marketing, sales, and customer success teams.
* Align stakeholders around product goals, priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes.
* Communicate product decisions clearly and manage expectations across teams.
* Partner with marketing, sales, and customer success to develop go\-to\-market strategies, launches, enablement, and customer education.



 Metrics, Analytics \& Experimentation
 


* Define clear KPIs and success metrics for products and features, such as CAC, conversion rate, retention, LTV, ARPU, engagement, and revenue.
* Monitor product performance and customer behavior through dashboards, analytics, and qualitative feedback.
* Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests, to validate hypotheses and drive continuous improvement.
* Use data and customer insights to identify opportunities, diagnose problems, and inform product decisions.



 Customer Advocacy
 


* Represent the customer perspective in product discussions and decision\-making.
* Engage directly with key customers and power users to understand needs, gather feedback, and validate solutions.
* Translate customer pain points into actionable product opportunities.
* Support customer\-facing teams in product discussions, strategic accounts, and escalations when required.



 Product Lifecycle Management

 Brand Operator

 Our Client is an exciting

 **Brand, Consumer, Growth and GTM** 
 .

 .

 What You Will Own

 This is an opportunity to work on a consumer brand

description:

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a
 **Product Analyst** 
 on the Business Intelligence \& Analytics Change Team, you will help integrate new Finance applications and analytical capabilities into BCG’s enterprise data warehouse and digital products, partnering with Business Intelligence \& Analytics Change Team subject matter experts to understand business needs, reporting requirements, and the capabilities needed to support effective decision\-making.
   

  

 Once requirements are defined, you will work closely with Solution Architects and Developers and independently lead implementation through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. A key part of your role will be testing and validating data in Snowflake and BI reports to ensure solutions meet defined business and reporting requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities Would Include**
* Partner with SMEs to gather, clarify, and document business and reporting requirements.
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements, data needs, and implementation plans.
* Lead implementation with Solution Architects and Developers, coordinating work through delivery.
* Analyze gaps between required analytical capabilities and Finance application data models.
* Develop and recommend solution options for review and decision by the Product Owner and SMEs.
* Define source\-to\-target data mappings and models that support scalable analysis and reporting.
* Test and validate data in Snowflake and BI reports, identifying discrepancies and ensuring solutions meet defined requirements.
* Analyze data anomalies and gaps in business logic, determine root causes, and coordinate resolution of BI reporting issues through the ServiceNow ticketing system.
* Support global users and partner with technical teams to troubleshoot and resolve data and reporting issues.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 3–5 years of experience in business intelligence, Finance reporting, data analytics, or related work.
* Hands\-on Snowflake experience querying, analyzing, testing, and validating data.
* Experience with SAP BusinessObjects or comparable enterprise BI and reporting solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.

* Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements and working with technical teams through implementation.

 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a member of the Business Intelligence \& Analytics Change Team, you will work closely with the Product Owner and subject matter experts to understand business and reporting needs, partnering with Solution Architects and Developers to translate those needs into scalable data and reporting solutions. You will also collaborate with Finance teams, Finance application owners, other Business Intelligence \& Analytics teams, and global end users. We are hiring Entrepreneurs\-in\-Residence (EIRs) to build new businesses from zero inside MedhaviOne. Each EIR reports to the Founders and owns one mandate end to end.
 



  





**Why Now?**




  





 Higher education is being rebuilt, and the people who build it now will shape the sector for decades.
 



 ·      Degrees are giving way to skills.
 



 ·      Classroom\-only learning is giving way to work\-integrated learning.
 



 ·      One\-size\-fits\-all programmes are giving way to new models designed with employers.
 



  





 For years, the strongest graduates from top institutes walked past education. That is changing. The capital, talent and ambition now entering the sector mean it is moving fast.
 



  





 This role is a 2–3 year founder apprenticeship, fully paid. You build a real business, with our partner network and university behind you.
 



  





**(I) EIR, Enterprise Growth**



* **What you build \-** 
 Go\-to\-market, sales motion, and thought leadership for MedhaviOne Enterprise, serving employers and industries that need job\-ready talent
* **Where it can lead \-** 
 Growth Head, then Business Head for the portfolio
* **Best\-fit background \-** 
 B2B marketing or growth in SaaS or AI companies



  





**(II) EIR, New Learning Brand**

 A curated online marketplace of high\-value, work\-integrated upskilling and reskilling programmes, co\-developed with premier institutes and universities

 Category Head, then Business Head for the portfolio

 Growth, category or programme roles at leading EdTech platforms

* Pull in marketing, technology, academic and partnerships teams to get things done.
* Build a lean team as the business proves itself.
* Put plans on a page: numbers first, with the insight beside them.

**Must have** 




  




* A degree from an IIT, IIM or other top\-tier institute, or a track record that speaks just as loudly.
* 2–5 years of work experience.
* Something you built from scratch, and can show.
* A minimum commitment to 2–3 years of hands\-on building with us.
* Clear, sharp writing. Your application is the first test.

* For Enterprise Growth: B2B marketing or growth experience in SaaS or AI.
* For New Learning Brand: EdTech experience or new\-age education businesses.

 You meet deadlines, and flag early when you cannot.

 You build things and businesses you would put your name on.

 You work with 600\+ enterprise partners and a university campus.

 as part of the form and is mandatory for consideration. Apply Here:

 **)** 




  





**Please note:**

 the selection process. Please do not email your application separately.
 



  





**About MedhaviOne**

**Professional \& Technical Skills**

* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, and client relationship skills, with the ability to explain complex process, AI, data, and technology choices in business terms.

* Experience working in fast\-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments and managing multiple workstreams with client\-facing accountability.
* Experience contributing to business development, proposal or RFP development, reusable assets, or thought leadership, and coaching junior practitioners, is preferred.


**Additional Information**
* Experience in consumer\-led B2C industries is strongly preferred, including Consumer Goods \& Services, Retail, Travel, Fashion \& Luxury, High Tech, Communications \& Media, or similar sectors with scaled commerce operations.

* Applied knowledge of Agent Experience (AX) Design principles — including agent autonomy, handoffs, escalation, controls, and human oversight — is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to connect process improvements to measurable commerce outcomes such as productivity, speed\-to\-market, content quality, discoverability, conversion, GMV, or customer experience.
