title: Decision Analyst
description:
Join us as a Decision Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 The Decision Intelligence team at Barclays drives strategic business impact by applying advanced analytics and data science to solve complex challenges. Focused on enhancing profitability, customer experience, and operational efficiency, the team builds analytical capabilities to inform business strategies and case development. By uncovering growth opportunities, optimizing customer and digital strategies, and improving risk management, they deliver data\-driven and decision focused solutions in collaboration with stakeholders, fostering a culture of informed decision making and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
   

  

 To be a successful Decision Analyst, you should have experience in:
   

  

  

* Synthesizing business knowledge, market research, and analytics to drive strategic outcomes.
* Understanding value drivers across products and services, linking customer, operational, and financial levers.
* Breaking down complex challenges using frameworks such as MECE, hypothesis\-driven approaches, 5 WHYs, 80/20, and decision trees.
* Using Python, SQL, Excel, and Tableau to transform data into actionable insights.
* Generating insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Crafting compelling, data\-backed narratives for senior stakeholders and delivering powerful executive presentations.
* Coordinating cross\-functional teams and tracking benefits realization.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong communication and storytelling.
* Good at problem solving skills and strategic thinking.
* People leadership potential and guiding/coaching less experienced colleagues.
* AI Awareness/Adoption.


 You may be assessed on essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, developing robust decision models, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the departments.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and extraction of relevant data from various internal and external sources.
* Performing sensitivity analysis and scenario planning.
* Monitoring and evaluation of the performance of existing models.
* Development and implementation of data quality control procedures.
* Building and validation of quantitative models to support decision\-making across different business areas.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**
**Role:** 
 Revenue Management
   

  

**Level:** 
 Deputy Manager /Manager
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Associate Director \- Revenue Management
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
   

  

**About The Function**
 Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.
   

  

 The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.
   

  

 This is further complemented by a world\-class post\-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self\-help features or our hand\-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry\-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.
   

  

 At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip\-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an independent, self\-starting, quick\-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross\-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high\-quality work under pressure.
   

  

**What Will You Be Doing**
**P\&L and Revenue Management**
* Own and manage the business P\&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.


**Growth Strategy Development**
* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short\- and long\-term growth strategies, influencing key cross\-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.
* Use these insights to shape business and marketing strategies, driving greater engagement and higher conversion rates.


**Customer Engagement \& Marketing Collaboration**
* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.
* Collaborate with various marketing functions to maximize order volumes while maintaining a healthy ROAS.


**Collaboration with Product \& Operations Stakeholders**
* Partner with product teams to develop first\-class, customer\-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.


**Data Analysis \& Reporting**
* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* MBA from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer\-facing, technology\-enabled business—preferably in the e\-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high\-growth, data\-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.


**Key Success Factors For The Role**
* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.
* High energy, team\-oriented, and brings a positive, can\-do attitude.
* Strong understanding of data analysis, with hands\-on experience in data\-driven decision\-making.
* Proven track record of driving business growth through both tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple proj ects simultaneously.

 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 CFO Change Automation team, which is part of CFO COO group in involved in various analytics, automation and reporting \& governance needs that helps the CFO group analyze and address key challenges \& provide relevant solutions using ET or any other relevant technologies. The team provides deep dive analysis by deploying analytics and data mining tools like SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, Workiva etc. as well as is involved in setting up automated solutions for complex BAU processes.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 CFO Change Automation team aims in driving opportunity assessment, prioritization, and process automation \& governance across all verticals of CFO.
   

  

 In support of CFO Change objectives this position will be responsible for managing the end to end delivery of complex initiatives from a functional leader perspective.  This person will be responsible for assisting business teams to expedite implementation of automated solutions through collaboration with other CFO and Enterprise Architecture teams to provide a consistent and governed approach in accordance with data management and tech strategy models. This person would serve in an execution role to support business with new and emerging tools used in process optimization efforts and driving Operational Excellence.
   

  

 This initiative execution/ business integration role will require the individual to lead, manage, and deliver on the end to end scope of Automation initiatives. This individual will get significant exposure to senior stakeholders across CFO through leading initiative routines to communicate project progress, governance, new opportunities and key decisions.

* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate functional requirements into AI\-driven agent solutions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, and control standards.
* Stay updated with evolving AI and automation toolsets, enabling scalable and practical AI\-powered workflows
* Lead development of solutions on low\-code/no\-code platforms (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau, automation tools, workflow engines)
* Effectively manage the end to end delivery of their Automation projects / initiatives

 Technical certifications in Microsoft Copilot M365, Studio, RPA tools like UiPath, Alteryx Advanced and Tableau preferred

* Good analytical skills and ability identify/raise questions

 Gurugram/Mumbai

* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.

 7 to 10 years

description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Product Manager – AI Security
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time

 November 2026 or February 2027
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 We're hiring
 **two technical Product Managers** 
 to own core areas of this new AI security platform.
   

  

 You'll join one of two workstreams:
   

  

* Cloud Discovery: Build a continuously updated inventory of the AI agents, models, and AI\-enabled applications running across customers' cloud environments, including the data and permissions they can access. This role requires strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud security.
* AI Security Platform: Own a core area of the platform across gateway, agentic security, forensics, or shared platform capabilities, working closely with engineering, security research, design, and enterprise customers.


 Both roles require a PM who has
 **shipped B2B security or infrastructure products** 
 , is technically comfortable working with engineering teams, and uses AI tools as part of their daily product workflow.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization for your product area from discovery through launch.
* Lead customer discovery with CISOs, security architects, and cloud/AI platform teams, translating customer needs into clear problem statements and PRDs.
* Partner with engineering and security research on scope, technical trade\-offs, and delivery, and participate in technical design reviews.
* Define success metrics and ensure the product measures adoption, coverage, and detection effectiveness.
* Work with product marketing, sales engineering, and support on positioning, enablement, and launches.
* Track the evolving AI security landscape, including agent frameworks, LLM providers, regulation, and competitors, and translate relevant developments into product strategy.
* Use AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, and day\-to\-day product work.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS, including 2\+ years working on security, cloud infrastructure, or developer\-facing products.
* Proven track record of shipping products used by enterprise security or infrastructure teams, with measurable outcomes.
* Strong technical fluency: comfortable reading API specifications, discussing distributed\-systems trade\-offs, and understanding how LLM applications and AI agents are deployed.
* Strong written communication and the ability to produce clear PRDs, decision documents, and executive updates.
* Practical, daily use of AI tools and LLM/agentic workflows in your own product work.
* Fluent English and comfortable collaborating with distributed teams across time zones.
* Strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast\-moving environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Product experience in cybersecurity, including DLP, CASB, SIEM, EDR, CSPM/CNAPP, or AI security.
* Strong practical knowledge of a major cloud provider, including services, IAM, and inventory/audit APIs.
* Engineering background or hands\-on scripting experience, particularly Python.
* Experience working with AI compliance and regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic workflows into product teams.


 AI\-First Team
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team works.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in your own product work, including the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed your workflow.
   

  

 We're looking for people who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for research, productivity, problem\-solving, and decision\-making** 
 , not simply as a writing or autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Shape a new product line at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Work directly with engineering, security research, and enterprise customers on emerging security challenges.
* Own a significant product area with high visibility and influence.
* Help define how enterprises discover, understand, and secure AI systems.
* Join a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of daily work.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

title: Analyst - D2C Merchandising
description:
**Job Description \- Analyst \- D2C Merchandising** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A sharp analytical mind combined with a genuine feel for on\-site consumer experience — you notice when a layout, widget, or page just doesn't convert, and you can prove why with data
* Strong grounding in A/B testing methodology — designing hypotheses, sizing tests, and reading results correctly rather than eyeballing conversion bumps
* Comfort blending qualitative and quantitative research — you can watch session recordings on tools like Hotjar/Clarity and run user interviews, and translate what you see into a testable hypothesis
* Fluency with product/funnel analytics — you can dig into event\-level data to find exactly where the funnel is leaking and size the opportunity to fix it
* An ownership mindset over the D2C storefront as a whole — you think of every widget, PDP section, sale page, and search result as real estate to be optimized, not just decorated
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype page changes, synthesize research, and move faster than a traditional analyst would
* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it



  





**Skills Required:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* A/B Testing \& Experimentation Design: framing hypotheses, calculating sample size and test duration, and reading out results correctly
* Session Recording \& Behavioural Research: hands\-on use of Hotjar and/or Microsoft Clarity to watch and synthesize real user sessions into friction points
* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery
* Analytics Tools: GA4 (or similar) for on\-site behaviour, a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting, and Excel/Sheets for modelling
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype pages, synthesize research, and speed up analysis



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with event\-based product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude
* Basic familiarity with Figma or similar to mock up widget/page changes
* Prior experience with PDP or CRO optimization in a D2C or e\-commerce business
* Python for basic scripting on data pulls or test analysis



  





**What will you do?** 




**Own the D2C Storefront Real Estate** 



* Decide how every widget on the homepage, category, and PDP pages should be placed and sequenced
* Plan and prioritize sale and campaign page layouts across major sale events
* Continuously audit the storefront for underperforming or redundant real estate



**Run A/B Testing \& Experimentation** 



* Design and run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, widgets, and on\-site promotions
* Define success metrics, calculate sample size, and read out results with statistical rigour
* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points
* Run user interviews to go deeper on the 'why' behind observed behaviour
* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations



**Diagnose Funnel Leakages** 



* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off
* Quantify the size of each leakage and prioritize fixes by potential impact
* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data
* Monitor on\-site search and discovery performance and recommend improvements to relevance and merchandizing rules



  





**Translate Insights into Merchandising Recommendations** 



* Convert findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for the merchandising operations team to execute
* You own the analysis and the recommendation — the merchandising team owns execution — so follow\-through and clarity matter



  





**Work Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 



* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible timings
* Diverse work environment



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding:** 




 We raised $5 million in a Series A funding.

Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies
 **.
   

  

 Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it.** 
 VaynerMedia APAC is strong with a world\-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time \-\-\- PEOPLE.
   

  

 We’re looking for amazing people to join our team (more specifically, a
 **STRATEGY DIRECTOR** 
 ). The role is based in India
   

  

**Here’s where you come in...**
 You are a problem solver at heart and insanely curious about people, culture and technology. Most of all, you like to get your hands dirty, are obsessed with researching \& finding interesting things that are hidden from sight (even in the seemingly most mundane of places) and adept at translating your findings into compelling creative briefs, enjoy partnering with teams to see your work through from research to execution, and communicate your work with passion and conviction.
   

  

**What You Should Know About Our Team...**
 We’re collaborative and come from diverse backgrounds. We value creativity in research, and an outside\-in perspective when it comes to inspiration, strategic frameworks and problem\-solving. Technology has fundamentally changed the way we interact with others and the world around us, and we geek out about understanding behaviors in context, instead of probing humans in a petri dish.
   

  

**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia...**
 Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
   

  

**Overall** 
**Purpose**
 Strategy at VaynerMedia provides a crucial perspective on the business dynamics. We are a human centric, culture obsessed discipline where we dive deep into audience insights, media trends, cultural shifts, and tech innovations that inform our strategic recommendations. Our team is collectively redefining and modernizing the way our clients harness consumer and cultural intelligence, develop brand strategy and plan for attention.
   

  

**KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY**
* Identify data\-driven insights in a logical flow in order to deliver a compelling and enlightening story to client.
* Bring the consumer’s world to life through the use of qualitative and cultural mining, plus insightful synthesis of quantitative research.
* Demonstrate analytical and strategic skills to help solve client’s business problems.
* Stay abreast of the competitive landscape as it pertains to data, human centered research, and scalable qualitative insights delivering meaningful results for our clients.
* Define/identify new methodologies for cultural analysis and development of cultural anthropology products that unlock VaynerMedia’s ability to ‘culture hack’ at speed and transform our clients’ businesses.
* Evaluate creative concepts and communication opportunities and provide sound feedback and/or recommendations, as appropriate.
* Facilitating brainstorms, workshops and ideation sessions that drive greater creativity and innovation.
* Direct the strategic development of client presentations and other important communication; delivering clear, compelling and persuasive communications to all stakeholders.
* Brief creative teams for ideation and help facilitate brainstorms and workshops.


**Desired Skills \& Experience:**
* 7\+ years experience building integrated programs at a top agency working for Fortune 500 clients \-\- must have experience understanding the intersection of business strategy, consumer insights, and digital behavior and developing big, purposeful ideas.
* Bilingual fluent proficiency in English and Hindi is a must as the social, media, and campaign advertising strategy has to be in Hindi to service the local target market.
* Experience doing traditional, web, social, syndicated and primary research (incl.: NetBase, MRI, Sysomos, Brandwatch, eMarketer, Mintel, Google Analytics, Omniture; conducting IDIs, digital ethnographies, etc.)
* Dazzling presentation skills and presence in a room
* Ability to express complicated concepts in simple and digestible ways (“Explain it to a fifth grader”)
* Curious and lovely to get along with


 You would be leading a team of talented strategists, social listening analysts, and community experts. As such, there are many hats you’d have to wear from day 1\. You would need to conduct research, write briefs, guide work, pitch to clients \- really anything and everything it takes to get the job done and deliver fantastic, big, bold, beautiful work.
   

  

 Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start\-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

 Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS), established by the Ministry of Railways in 1986, is the premier IT organization supporting the digital needs of Indian Railways. Headquartered in New Delhi with regional offices in major metro cities, CRIS designs and operates information systems for passenger ticketing, freight operations, train control, asset management, and other core railway functions across India, including remote and challenging locations. Its workforce of around 800 professionals combines advanced IT expertise with deep railway domain knowledge, enabling CRIS to deliver robust, cost\-effective solutions for complex operational needs. CRIS actively adopts cutting\-edge technologies such as mobile ticketing, GPS\-based train tracking, RFID\-based asset tracking, and geo\-spatial databases, and is building a state\-of\-the\-art data center for railway IT systems. The organization continues to expand into emerging areas including asset protection, energy management, overhead electrification, parcel management, employee health, and comprehensive financial management.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Owner at CRIS is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Delhi, India, responsible for strategic oversight and direction of key information systems initiatives for Indian Railways. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include defining product and project vision, prioritizing technology roadmaps, and aligning IT solutions with operational and regulatory needs of the railway sector. The role involves collaborating with technical teams, railway domain experts, and government stakeholders to ensure that systems are scalable, secure, and cost\-effective. The Owner reviews project progress, manages risks, and makes decisions on resource allocation, timelines, and quality standards. ****Overview****
**About the Organisation**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Common Cancer, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

****About The Program****
 The Cancer, NCD and Mental Health portfolio aims to strengthen India's response to the growing burden of non\-communicable diseases by supporting governments to design, implement and scale sustainable models of prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.
   

  

 The portfolio currently supports programs across common cancers (breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers), chronic NCDs, mental health, comprehensive primary healthcare, digital health, implementation research, market shaping and health systems strengthening. The program works closely with national and state governments, development partners, academia, professional bodies and the private sector to develop scalable models that contribute towards India's National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD).

Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Senior Product Manager, Loyalty**
**Team Description**
 The role sits within the Loyalty Product organization and is specifically focused on assurance products strategy for members across Hotels.com, Vrbo, and BEX. The broader loyalty team currently works across multiple areas including loyalty for other brands such as Expedia \& Vrbo, 3P partnerships, AI/ML\-driven personalization, promotions \& incentives etc.
   

  

 The team partners closely with brand GMs, marketing, engineering, design, finance, legal and other product stakeholders to improve the loyalty experience, drive clearer value for travelers, and increase outcomes such as active members, first transactions, repeat bookings, and direct return behavior for Expedia Group.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Define the product vision and multi\-quarter roadmap for loyalty assurance products across brands.
* Set clear priorities across protection and flexibility offerings.
* Partner with InsurTech, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Brand teams to drive discovery, delivery, and launch readiness.
* Define the member value proposition and eligibility model for assurance benefits within One Key.
* Use data, experimentation, and market insight to evaluate product fit and member impact.
* Drive the in\-product member experience for assurance products.
* Align stakeholders around strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and investment decisions.
* Manage ambiguity, unblock dependencies, and keep multiple workstreams moving in a highly matrixed environment.
* Apply AI/ML and rule\-based contextualization and personalization to improve member relevance and business outcomes.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A clear cross\-brand assurance strategy that connects loyalty benefits to repeat booking and member retention.
* A prioritized roadmap that balances member value, commercial outcomes, and delivery feasibility.
* Strong partnership with InsurTech that results in scalable, compliant, and brand\-appropriate launches.
* Measurable improvement in loyalty engagement, repeat purchase, and assurance adoption and usage.
* Clear alignment across business and technical stakeholders throughout discovery and delivery.


**Who You Are**
* An experienced product leader with a track record of owning complex, technical, cross\-functional products.
* Strong at product vision, roadmap definition, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
* Comfortable operating across brands, geographies, and business models.
* A clear communicator who can simplify sophisticated product and commercial concepts.
* Data\-driven, customer\-focused, and comfortable making decisions in ambiguity.
* Skilled at leading through influence and collaborating across functions without direct authority.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience leading complex product initiatives.
* Experience leading highly technical consumer or platform products in a matrixed organization.
* Proven track record of building and scaling products with multiple stakeholders and business constraints.
* Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Analytics, and business stakeholders.
* Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with travel, fintech, insurance, loyalty, or marketplace products.
* Experience working with partner\-led product models and regulated or quasi\-regulated offerings.
* Experience with experimentation, personalization, segmentation, or behavioral analytics.
* Ability to connect customer needs to measurable commercial and member outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence without direct authority.


**Why this role matters**

 Pluang is Indonesia’s leading multi\-asset investment platform, offering products such as US Stocks, Crypto, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure—so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $110M\+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we’re one of Indonesia’s fastest\-growing fintechs.
 
 Discover more about our vision here.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are hiring a Senior Product Manager based in Gurgaon to join our Global Products team. You will own and drive product outcomes across global investing products (e.g. US Stocks, ETFs, Options, Leverage, Commodities, Forex and adjacent platform capabilities), translating strategy into shipped products with high quality and operational excellence.
 



 Given Pluang’s startup environment, scope can evolve over time. A meaningful part of this role will also involve helping build and launch Pluang Philippines (PH)—a highly exciting zero\-to\-one journey where you will launch the product by creating core platform flows (e.g., onboarding/KYC, wallet, top up/cash out, portfolio, and key trading/investing journeys) in a new market.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




**1\. Own delivery and outcomes across Global Products (US Stocks \& Securities and beyond)** 



* Drive execution of roadmap items across US Stocks, Options, ETFs, Leverage and other products\- balancing customer value, risk, and operational constraints.
* Translate strategy into crisp PRDs, user stories, and release plans; ensure high\-quality delivery and clear success metrics.
* Own post\-launch iteration based on data, user feedback, and operational insights (not just shipping features).



**2\. Contribute to PH expansion (zero\-to\-one) through platform flows and market readiness**

* Work with Strategy/Compliance/Partnerships to translate market requirements into a phased roadmap (MVP → iteration → scale).
* Ensure PH flows are measurable, reliable, and launch\-ready with strong operational and compliance alignment.



**3\. Build and scale core investing journeys with a high bar for trust and usability** 



* Improve key journeys such as discovery → onboarding → funding → trade execution → portfolio → reporting.
* Drive UX improvements informed by funnel analytics, user feedback, and market benchmarks to increase conversion and repeat investing behaviors.
* Ensure clarity and transparency in user\-facing experiences (pricing/fees, leverage risks, order status, trade confirmations).



**4\. Drive data\-informed optimization and experimentation** 



* Own instrumentation and metrics for your domains; partner with Data to ensure dashboards are trusted and actionable.
* Run structured experiments (A/B tests and iterative rollouts) to improve conversion funnels and product adoption.
* Diagnose performance issues and drop\-offs using cohort and funnel analysis; propose and execute solutions.



**5\. Lead cross\-functional coordination and operational excellence** 



* Partner with Engineering, Design, QA, Compliance, Operations, and Support to deliver end\-to\-end outcomes.
* Proactively manage dependencies, execution risks, and stakeholder alignment—especially in regulated workflows.
* Improve internal product operations: clearer processes, better launch checklists, stronger incident/learning loops.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 4\+ years of Product Management experience (or equivalent), ideally in fintech, brokerage, trading, payments, or other regulated consumer products.
* Experience shipping complex product surfaces end\-to\-end with measurable impact.
* Exposure to global investing products (US stocks/ETFs/leverage/derivatives) is a plus.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong execution and product judgment: clear problem framing, crisp requirements, thoughtful prioritization.
* Strong analytical ability: funnels, cohorts, experimentation rigor, and data\-informed decision making.
* Strong cross\-functional leadership across Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, and Operations.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity while maintaining a high quality bar and strong stakeholder alignment.



  





**Mindset** 



* Ownership\-driven and outcome\-oriented; comfortable being accountable for business and customer impact.
* High bar for trust, compliance readiness, and operational excellence.
* Curious and adaptable—able to flex scope as business priorities evolve.

title: Product Manager
description:
We are seeking a data\-driven and execution\-focused Product Manager (4–5 years of
 



 experience) to own and scale our core payment infrastructure. In this role, you will be
 



 responsible for building seamless checkout experiences, integrating payment gateways (PGs),
 



 optimizing transaction routing, and leading consumer/merchant payment flows across UPI,
 



 cards, netbanking, mandates and alternative payment methods.
 



 You will act as the bridge between engineering, design, risk, compliance, and partner
 



 banks/aggregators to drive higher transaction success rates, reduce checkout friction, and
 



 maintain strict adherence to regulatory standards (NPCI/RBI).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Checkout \& PG Integrations: Own the end\-to\-end checkout funnel. Design, integrate, and optimize payment gateways, aggregators, routing engines, and tokenization solutions to lower latency and increase Payment Success Rates (PSR).
 



 • Payment journeys: product initiatives across payment stacks: UPI(Intent, Collect, QR, AutoPay, Credit on UPI), Cards – Debit \& credit, Netbanking, Wallets and BNPL
 



 • Product Discovery \& Execution: Define the payment strategy, prioritize the product backlog, and write clear, engineering\-ready PRDs with explicit technical acceptance criteria and edge\-case handling logic.
 



 • Conversion Optimization \& Funnel Analysis: Use analytical tools (SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude) to identify drop\-off points, design A/B tests, and optimize payment recovery flows (e.g., auto\-retry mechanisms, dynamic fallback options).
 



 • Reconciliation \& Settlement Operations: Collaborate with finance and operations to build reliable automated reconciliation, refund, payout, and chargeback/dispute resolution workflows.
 



 • Regulatory Compliance \& Security: Maintain strict compliance with RBI, NPCI, PCI\-DSS guidelines, and PA/PG regulatory frameworks from initial spec to production rollout.
 



 • Cross\-Functional Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Risk \& Fraud, Legal, and Bank/Partner Integration teams to deliver features on schedule.
 



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 




 • Experience: 4–5 years of hands\-on Product Management experience within Fintech,
 



 Digital Payments, or E\-commerce.
 



 • Domain Mastery: Proven experience with PG/PA integrations, checkout funnel
 



 optimization, UPI infrastructure (P2P/P2M, AutoPay)
 



 • Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to read API documentation, map sequence diagrams, understand webhook architectures, and collaborate closely with backend/infrastructure engineers.
 



 • Data\-Driven Mindset: Hands\-on experience analyzing funnel metrics, building reports via SQL or BI tools, and conducting hypothesis\-driven experimentation.
 



 • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem, including NPCI circulars, RBI payment guidelines, and tokenization mandates.
 



 • Execution Excellence: Track record of taking complex 0\-to\-1 or 1\-to\-10 payment products from concept to launch in fast\-paced environments.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Experience with merchant onboarding/activation flows or developer\-facing APIs/SDKs.
 



 • Hands\-on familiarity with fraud mitigation tools, risk engines, or AI\-assisted product development workflows.

title: Nykaa - Product Manager II
description:
**Role : Product Manager II \| Nykaa Fashion**
**Location :** 
 Gurgaon \|
 **Experience :** 
 2 \- 4 years \|
 **Team :** 
 Product \- Nykaa Fashion
   

  

 Fashion meets Product. And we're looking for someone who gets both.
   

  

 Nykaa Fashion is building the next generation of fashion shopping experiences \- experiences that are more visual, inspiring, social and AI\-native.
   

  

 We're looking for a Product Manager II to work on some of our newest bets : ideas that may start with a customer insight, prototype or experiment and have the potential to become entirely new experiences for millions of shoppers.
   

  

 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap and optimize it by 2%.
   

  

 You'll find problems worth solving, build from zero, experiment quickly and scale what works.
   

  

 And there's one thing we care about beyond the usual PM toolkit : You should genuinely love fashion.
   

  

 You notice what people are wearing. You know when a trend is taking off. You have opinions on how people discover brands, put together looks and decide what to buy.
   

  

 You don't just work on fashion. You talk about it. You follow it. You wear it.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 You'll work on 0 \- 1 bets for Nykaa Fashion across areas such as :
   

  

* New Discovery Experiences : Rethink how shoppers discover fashion beyond traditional homepages, PLPs and search \- from visual and inspiration\-led discovery to new content\-led shopping formats.
* AI x Fashion : Explore how Generative AI can change fashion shopping \- styling, personalization, conversational shopping, visual discovery and completely new interfaces.
* Content x Commerce : Build experiences where reels, creators, UGC, trends and editorial content become native parts of the shopping journey.


**What You'll Do**
* Build 0 \- 1 : Take ambiguous ideas from customer problems \- hypothesis \- prototype \- MVP \- experiment \- scale.
* Think customer\-first : Spend time understanding how people actually discover, evaluate and buy fashion \- not just what funnel dashboards tell us.
* Experiment aggressively : Run rapid experiments, learn what works and be equally comfortable scaling a winner or killing an idea.
* Use AI as a product primitive : Prototype with LLMs, multimodal models and emerging AI capabilities rather than treating AI as an add\-on.
* Own outcomes : Define clear customer and business metrics and take accountability for impact, not feature launches.
* Work deeply with Design \& Engineering : Build alongside designers and engineers from day one rather than throwing requirements over the fence.
* Stay culturally curious : Track fashion, creators, Gen Z behaviour, global commerce products and emerging consumer experiences \- and translate those signals into product ideas.


**Who We're Looking For**
 2 \- 4 years of Product Management experience, preferably in consumer internet or e\-commerce.
   

  

**You Will Probably Thrive Here If**
* You've shipped meaningful consumer products and can demonstrate measurable impact.
* You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and limited precedent.
* You have strong product intuition but are equally comfortable getting into data.
* You understand experimentation, funnels and consumer behaviour.
* You can work effectively with Design, Engineering, Analytics and Business teams.
* You're naturally curious about AI and how it changes consumer products.
* You move fast, prototype before over\-specifying, and learn from real users.
* Prior e\-commerce, discovery, personalization, content, social commerce or AI product experience is a strong plus.


 And the biggest plus? You are a fashion enthusiast. Not because your resume says Fashion / E\-commerce. Because you genuinely have a point of view on fashion. You follow brands, creators and trends. You understand why someone saves a look on Instagram, searches for it on Google, asks a friend about it and eventually buys something completely different.
   

  

 We want someone who can bring that instinct into the products they build.
   

  

**Why Nykaa Fashion? :**
 Because fashion e\-commerce still has a lot left to reinvent.
   

  

 Most shopping experiences today are built around catalogues, filters and funnels. The next generation will increasingly be built around inspiration, identity, creators, personalization and AI.
   

  

 At Nykaa Fashion, you'll get the scale of a major consumer platform with the opportunity to operate like a small 0 \- 1 product team. Millions of shoppers. Thousands of brands. And plenty of unsolved problems.
   

  

 Come build what fashion shopping looks like next!

title: Senior Associate – Brand & Growth
description:
Senior Associate – Brand \& Growth
 
**Herbaria – Modern Botanicals** 




**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



**Experience:** 
 3–5 years
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time, on\-site
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Founders
   




 About Herbaria
 
 Herbaria – Modern Botanicals is a luxury, sustainable beauty brand creating colourful, fragrant and sensorial skincare rituals.
 



 We believe sustainability doesn't have to be boring. Herbaria brings together
 **botanicals, beauty, fragrance, design and conscious living** 
 to create products that are as beautiful to experience as they are considered for the planet.
 



 As we grow across
 **D2C, retail, hospitality, gifting and international markets** 
 , we're looking for someone who wants to grow with the brand and eventually take ownership of it.
   




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Associate – Brand \& Growth** 
 to work closely with the founders across the many facets of building Herbaria.
 



 This is a
 **high\-ownership, hands\-on role** 
 that sits at the intersection of
 **brand, marketing, growth and business development** 
 .
 



 You will help shape how Herbaria looks, sounds, communicates and grows — while also being comfortable stepping into a commercial conversation and helping bring business to the brand.
 



 This is not a role for someone who wants to work within a narrow job description.
 



 We're looking for someone who can
 **think strategically, execute independently, build relationships and get things moving.** 




 The long\-term opportunity is to grow into a
 **Brand Manager** 
 and progressively take greater ownership of Herbaria.
 


 What You Will Work On
 
  




 1\. Brand \& Brand Building
 * Help develop and execute Herbaria's brand strategy and calendar.
* Translate the founders' vision into consistent brand communication and experiences.
* Develop ideas for campaigns, launches, activations and brand initiatives.
* Maintain consistency across visual identity, tone of voice and consumer touchpoints.
* Stay closely connected to the beauty, wellness, fragrance, fashion and luxury landscape.
* Track competitors and emerging consumer trends.
* Bring fresh ideas that can make Herbaria more distinctive and desirable.



 You should have a strong instinct for
 **what feels right for the brand** 
 — not simply what is trending.
   




 2\. Marketing \& Campaigns
 * Plan and execute marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Work on new product launches, seasonal campaigns and gifting campaigns.
* Develop campaign briefs and coordinate with designers, photographers, creators and agencies.
* Work closely with the performance marketing team to align brand and growth objectives.
* Review campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve.
* Support the development of Herbaria's annual marketing calendar.



 You will be expected to take projects from
 **idea → brief → execution → review** 
 , rather than simply coordinate between teams.
   




 3\. Content, Social \& Creators
 * Help shape Herbaria's content strategy and calendar.
* Develop content ideas, concepts and creative briefs.
* Work closely with the creative team on social media and campaign content.
* Manage relationships with relevant creators and influencers.
* Identify opportunities for UGC, collaborations and brand storytelling.
* Ensure our content feels distinctive, elevated and unmistakably Herbaria.


 4\. Growth
 * Work with the founders and marketing team to identify opportunities for business growth.
* Track D2C, marketplace, retail and other channel performance.
* Understand key metrics such as revenue, AOV, conversion, repeat purchase and customer acquisition.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition and retention.
* Work with performance marketing and marketplace partners to support growth initiatives.
* Use data and customer insights to inform marketing and brand decisions.



 You
 **must be commercially curious and comfortable with numbers.**



 5\. Partnerships \& Business Development
 
 This role will also have a meaningful commercial component.
 



 When opportunities arise, you should be comfortable representing Herbaria and helping turn relationships into business.
 



 This may include:
 


* Hotels, resorts, spas and hospitality groups
* Premium retail and lifestyle stores
* Corporate and luxury gifting
* Cafés, restaurants and experiential spaces
* Brand collaborations
* Distribution and international opportunities



  





 You will be involved in:
 


* Identifying potential partners
* Reaching out and initiating conversations
* Presenting Herbaria and its products
* Preparing proposals and presentations
* Coordinating samples
* Following up with prospects
* Participating in commercial discussions
* Supporting negotiations and closing opportunities
* Maintaining relationships with existing and potential partners



  





**We expect you to be confident enough to sell an idea, sell a product and represent the brand in a room.** 



 What We're Looking ForExperience
 * 3–5 years of experience in brand management, marketing, growth, partnerships or a related role.
* Experience in
 **beauty, skincare, fashion, luxury, lifestyle, hospitality, FMCG or D2C** 
 is preferred.
* Experience working with a growing or entrepreneurial brand is a strong advantage.


 We Care More About Your Mindset Than Your Exact Job Title
 
 We're looking for someone who is:
 



**Brand\-sensitive** 




 You understand aesthetics, storytelling, positioning and why certain brands create desire.
 



**Commercially minded** 




 You understand that building a beautiful brand and building a successful business need to happen together.
 



**Proactive** 




 You don't wait for instructions for every next step. You see something that needs to be done and take it forward.
 



**Curious** 




 You want to understand the consumer, the category and the business — not just complete assigned tasks.
 



**Articulate** 




 You can communicate confidently with founders, clients, creators, agencies, retailers and hospitality partners.
 



**Organised** 




 You can manage multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines without things falling through the cracks.
 



**Hands\-on** 




 You are comfortable doing the work yourself when required.
 



**Entrepreneurial** 




 You enjoy building in an environment where there isn't always a predefined playbook.
 



 Become a trusted owner of important parts of the business.
 



  




 The bigger opportunity
 
 The goal isn't simply to hire someone to execute tasks.
 



**We want to develop someone who can eventually manage and grow Herbaria as a brand.** 




 You will work closely with the founders and get exposure to the complete process of building a consumer brand — from
 **strategy and product launches to content, creators, retail, hospitality, gifting, partnerships and growth.** 




  




 Why Herbaria?
 
 At Herbaria, you'll be joining at a stage where there is still a lot to build.
 



 You won't be stepping into a large organisation with a fixed playbook and a narrow role.
 



 You'll have the opportunity to
 **shape the playbook with us.** 




 If you're ambitious, curious, commercially minded and excited by the idea of building a distinctive modern beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you.
   




 To ApplyApply on the job post or drop us your resume on Info@herbaria.co.in
